<i class="t-kw">const</i> server <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">createServer</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-fn">buildUseCases</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>
<pre class="cb-body cb-diff" id="a22-diff" hidden><code><span class="dl ctx"> import { buildUseCases } from "./composition";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import { createAcervoTables } from "./modules/acervo";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import { createAutoriaTables } from "./modules/autoria";</span><span class="dl add">+import { createCirculacaoTables } from "./modules/circulacao";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import { createServer } from "./server";</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> createAutoriaTables();</span><span class="dl ctx"> createAcervoTables();</span><span class="dl add">+createCirculacaoTables();</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> const server = createServer(buildUseCases());</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> console.log(`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`);</span></code></pre>
</div>
<p>E o <code>server.ts</code> registra as rotas — os erros das regras novas já caem no <code>errorResponse</code> que existe: <strong>Substitua</strong> <code>src/server.ts</code> — as linhas em destaque são as que mudam:</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="tgl" data-target="a23-diff" data-alt="a23">ver o que mudou</button><button class="cp" data-code="a23">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="a23"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">Hono</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"hono"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-kw">type</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">UseCases</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./composition"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">DomainError</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">InvalidValue</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./shared/domain-errors"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> registerRoutes <i class="t-kw">as</i> registerAcervo <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./modules/acervo"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> registerRoutes <i class="t-kw">as</i> registerAutoria <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./modules/autoria"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<strong class="ln-new"><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> registerRoutes <i class="t-kw">as</i> registerCirculacao <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./modules/circulacao"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">InvalidInput</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">NotFound</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">RuleConflict</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./shared/errors"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">errorResponse</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">unknown</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>error <i class="t-kw">instanceof</i> <i class="t-typ">InvalidInput</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i><i class="t-pun">|</i> error <i class="t-kw">instanceof</i> <i class="t-typ">InvalidValue</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> error<i class="t-pun">.</i>message <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">400</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>error <i class="t-kw">instanceof</i> <i class="t-typ">NotFound</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> error<i class="t-pun">.</i>message <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>error <i class="t-kw">instanceof</i> <i class="t-typ">RuleConflict</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i><i class="t-pun">|</i> error <i class="t-kw">instanceof</i> <i class="t-typ">DomainError</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> error<i class="t-pun">.</i>message <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">error</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>error<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Erro interno"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">500</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">createServer</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>useCases<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">UseCases</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> porta <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Number</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>process<i class="t-pun">.</i>env<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-typ">PORT</i> <i class="t-pun">?</i><i class="t-pun">?</i> <i class="t-num">3000</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> app <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">Hono</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  app<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>contexto<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> contexto<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> message<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"API da Biblioteca"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-fn">registerAutoria</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>app<i class="t-pun">,</i> useCases<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-fn">registerAcervo</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>app<i class="t-pun">,</i> useCases<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<strong class="ln-new">  <i class="t-fn">registerCirculacao</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>app<i class="t-pun">,</i> useCases<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

  app<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">notFound</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>contexto<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i>
    contexto<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Recurso não encontrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">404</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  app<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">onError</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>error<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-fn">errorResponse</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>error<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">serve</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> port<i class="t-pun">:</i> porta<i class="t-pun">,</i> fetch<i class="t-pun">:</i> app<i class="t-pun">.</i>fetch <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i></code></pre>
<pre class="cb-body cb-diff" id="a23-diff" hidden><code><span class="dl ctx"> import { Hono } from "hono";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import type { UseCases } from "./composition";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import { DomainError, InvalidValue } from "./shared/domain-errors";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import { registerRoutes as registerAcervo } from "./modules/acervo";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import { registerRoutes as registerAutoria } from "./modules/autoria";</span><span class="dl add">+import { registerRoutes as registerCirculacao } from "./modules/circulacao";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import { InvalidInput, NotFound, RuleConflict } from "./shared/errors";</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> function errorResponse(error: unknown): Response {</span><span class="dl ctx">   if (error instanceof InvalidInput || error instanceof InvalidValue) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });</span><span class="dl ctx">   }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   if (error instanceof NotFound) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 404 });</span><span class="dl ctx">   }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   if (error instanceof RuleConflict || error instanceof DomainError) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 409 });</span><span class="dl ctx">   }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   console.error(error);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   return Response.json({ error: "Erro interno" }, { status: 500 });</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> export function createServer(useCases: UseCases, porta = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000)) {</span><span class="dl ctx">   const app = new Hono();</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   app.get("/", (contexto) =&gt; contexto.json({ message: "API da Biblioteca" }));</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   registerAutoria(app, useCases);</span><span class="dl ctx">   registerAcervo(app, useCases);</span><span class="dl add">+  registerCirculacao(app, useCases);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   app.notFound((contexto) =&gt;</span><span class="dl ctx">     contexto.json({ error: "Recurso não encontrado" }, 404),</span><span class="dl ctx">   );</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   app.onError((error) =&gt; errorResponse(error));</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   return Bun.serve({ port: porta, fetch: app.fetch });</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="fase-head" id="passo-14"><div class="fase-n">14</div><div class="fase-t"><h2>Fronteira · a fitness function conhece a tabela nova</h2></div></div>
<div class="fase-body">
<p>O <code>bun run verificar</code> sabe quem é dono de cada tabela por um mapa escrito à mão. Uma tabela que não entra no mapa fica desprotegida: qualquer módulo poderia fazer <code>SELECT</code> em <code>emprestimos</code> sem o script reclamar.</p>
<p><strong>Substitua</strong> <code>scripts/check-boundaries.ts</code> — as linhas em destaque são as que mudam:</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="tgl" data-target="a24-diff" data-alt="a24">ver o que mudou</button><button class="cp" data-code="a24">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="a24"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">Glob</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"bun"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> dirname<i class="t-pun">,</i> join<i class="t-pun">,</i> normalize <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"node:path"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> problems<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-com">/** Quem é o dono de cada tabela. Nenhum módulo cita uma tabela que não é dele. */</i>
<i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-typ">TABELAS</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Record</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  livros<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"acervo"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  autores<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"autoria"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<strong class="ln-new">  emprestimos<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"circulacao"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> file <i class="t-kw">of</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">Glob</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"src/modules/**/*.ts"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">scan</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"."</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> module <i class="t-pun">=</i> file<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">2</i><i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> code <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">file</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>file<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">text</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> found <i class="t-kw">of</i> code<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">matchAll</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">/</i><i class="t-kw">from</i>\s<i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-str">"(\.[^"</i><i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-str">"/g)) {</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> target <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">normalize</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-fn">join</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-fn">dirname</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>file<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> found<i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">!</i>target<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">startsWith</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"src/modules/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">const</i> otherModule <i class="t-pun">=</i> target<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">2</i><i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>otherModule <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> module<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>target <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-str">`src/modules/${otherModule}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      problems<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">push</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`${file}\n      importa ${target}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>tabela<i class="t-pun">,</i> dono<i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-kw">of</i> <i class="t-typ">Object</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">entries</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">TABELAS</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>dono <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> module<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">RegExp</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`\\b(FROM|JOIN|INTO|UPDATE|TABLE|EXISTS)\\s+${tabela}\\b`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"i"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">test</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>code<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      problems<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">push</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
        <i class="t-str">`${file}\n      toca a tabela "${tabela}", que pertence a ${dono}`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
      <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>problems<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">error</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"Importações que furam a fronteira de módulo:\n"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> problema <i class="t-kw">of</i> problems<i class="t-pun">)</i> console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">error</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`  ${problema}\n`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  process<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">exit</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<pre class="cb-body cb-diff" id="a24-diff" hidden><code><span class="dl ctx"> import { Glob } from "bun";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import { dirname, join, normalize } from "node:path";</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> const problems: string[] = [];</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> /** Quem é o dono de cada tabela. Nenhum módulo cita uma tabela que não é dele. */</span><span class="dl ctx"> const TABELAS: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {</span><span class="dl ctx">   livros: "acervo",</span><span class="dl ctx">   autores: "autoria",</span><span class="dl add">+  emprestimos: "circulacao",</span><span class="dl ctx"> };</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> for await (const file of new Glob("src/modules/**/*.ts").scan(".")) {</span><span class="dl ctx">   const module = file.split("/")[2]!;</span><span class="dl ctx">   const code = await Bun.file(file).text();</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   for (const found of code.matchAll(/from\s+"(\.[^"]+)"/g)) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     const target = normalize(join(dirname(file), found[1]!));</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">     if (!target.startsWith("src/modules/")) continue;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">     const otherModule = target.split("/")[2]!;</span><span class="dl ctx">     if (otherModule === module) continue;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">     if (target !== `src/modules/${otherModule}`) {</span><span class="dl ctx">       problems.push(`${file}\n      importa ${target}`);</span><span class="dl ctx">     }</span><span class="dl ctx">   }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   for (const [tabela, dono] of Object.entries(TABELAS)) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     if (dono === module) continue;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">     if (new RegExp(`\\b(FROM|JOIN|INTO|UPDATE|TABLE|EXISTS)\\s+${tabela}\\b`, "i").test(code)) {</span><span class="dl ctx">       problems.push(</span><span class="dl ctx">         `${file}\n      toca a tabela "${tabela}", que pertence a ${dono}`,</span><span class="dl ctx">       );</span><span class="dl ctx">     }</span><span class="dl ctx">   }</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> if (problems.length &gt; 0) {</span><span class="dl ctx">   console.error("Importações que furam a fronteira de módulo:\n");</span><span class="dl ctx">   for (const problema of problems) console.error(`  ${problema}\n`);</span><span class="dl ctx">   process.exit(1);</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> console.log("Fronteiras de módulo respeitadas.");</span></code></pre>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> devolvido <i class="t-pun">=</i> devolver<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">execute</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>emprestimo<i class="t-pun">.</i>id<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-fn">expect</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>devolvido<i class="t-pun">.</i>devolvidoEm<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toBe</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"2026-09-10"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-fn">expect</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>devolvido<i class="t-pun">.</i>diasDeAtraso<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toBe</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-fn">expect</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>emprestar<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">execute</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-fn">pedido</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"2026-000001"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"2026202"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i>id<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toBe</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">2</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-fn">test</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"a devolução depois do prazo conta os dias de atraso"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> emprestar<i class="t-pun">,</i> devolver<i class="t-pun">,</i> relogio <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">scenario</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> emprestimo <i class="t-pun">=</i> emprestar<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">execute</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-fn">pedido</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"2026-000001"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  relogio<i class="t-pun">.</i>hoje <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">Date</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"2026-09-21"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-fn">expect</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>devolver<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">execute</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>emprestimo<i class="t-pun">.</i>id<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i>diasDeAtraso<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toBe</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">6</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-fn">test</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"um empréstimo não é devolvido duas vezes"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> emprestar<i class="t-pun">,</i> devolver <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">scenario</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> emprestimo <i class="t-pun">=</i> emprestar<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">execute</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-fn">pedido</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"2026-000001"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  devolver<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">execute</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>emprestimo<i class="t-pun">.</i>id<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-fn">expect</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> devolver<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">execute</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>emprestimo<i class="t-pun">.</i>id<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toThrow</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">RuleViolation</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="callout">O relógio do cenário é um objeto que o teste adianta: <code>relogio.hoje = new Date(...)</code>. É assim que “devolvido seis dias depois do prazo” vira um teste de oito linhas, sem esperar seis dias e sem mexer no relógio da máquina.</div>
</div>
<div class="fase-head" id="passo-16"><div class="fase-n">16</div><div class="fase-t"><h2>Como testar</h2></div></div>
<div class="fase-body">
<p>Primeiro a suíte inteira. Eram 27 testes; agora são 35.</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="a28">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="a28"><code><i class="t-cmd">bun</i> x tsc <i class="t-flag">--noEmit</i> <i class="t-pun">&amp;</i><i class="t-pun">&amp;</i> bun test
<i class="t-cmd">bun</i> run verificar</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cb cb-out">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">saída</span><div class="cb-actions"></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="a29"><code> 35 pass
 0 fail
 63 expect() calls
Ran 35 tests across 7 files.

Fronteiras de módulo respeitadas.</code></pre>
</div>
<p>Depois, a feature pela porta da frente. Suba o servidor com o banco do zero.</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="a30">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="a30"><code><i class="t-com"># banco do zero, para os números baterem com a saída abaixo</i>
<i class="t-cmd">rm</i> <i class="t-flag">-f</i> data/biblioteca.sqlite <i class="t-pun">&amp;</i><i class="t-pun">&amp;</i> bun run start</code></pre>
</div>
<p>Em outro terminal, prepare o acervo: dois livros entram, e o segundo sai por extravio.</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="a31">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="a31"><code><i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-s</i> <i class="t-flag">-o</i> /dev/null <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">"%{http_code}\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/livros \
  <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">'Content-Type: application/json'</i> \
  <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">'{"isbn":"9780141439587","titulo":"Emma","autorId":4}'</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-s</i> <i class="t-flag">-o</i> /dev/null <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">"%{http_code}\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/livros \
  <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">'Content-Type: application/json'</i> \
  <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">'{"isbn":"9780141439761","titulo":"Persuasão","autorId":4}'</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-s</i> <i class="t-flag">-o</i> /dev/null <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">"%{http_code}\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/livros/2026-000002/baixa \
  <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">'Content-Type: application/json'</i> <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">'{"motivo":"extravio"}'</i></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cb cb-out">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">resposta</span><div class="cb-actions"></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="a32"><code>201
201
200</code></pre>
</div>
<p>Agora a Circulação.</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="a33">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="a33"><code><i class="t-com"># 1) empréstimo válido: o prazo sai calculado</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-s</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/emprestimos \
  <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">'Content-Type: application/json'</i> \
  <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">'{"numeroRegistro":"2026-000001","matricula":"2026101"}'</i>

<i class="t-com"># 2) RN2: o mesmo exemplar, antes de voltar</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-s</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/emprestimos \
  <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">'Content-Type: application/json'</i> \
  <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">'{"numeroRegistro":"2026-000001","matricula":"2026202"}'</i>

<i class="t-com"># 3) RN1: exemplar que saiu do acervo</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-s</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/emprestimos \
  <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">'Content-Type: application/json'</i> \
  <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">'{"numeroRegistro":"2026-000002","matricula":"2026101"}'</i>

<i class="t-com"># 4) RN1: exemplar que o Acervo não conhece</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-s</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/emprestimos \
  <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">'Content-Type: application/json'</i> \
  <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">'{"numeroRegistro":"2026-999999","matricula":"2026101"}'</i>

<i class="t-com"># 5) validação de entrada, antes de qualquer regra</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-s</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/emprestimos \
  <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">'Content-Type: application/json'</i> <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">'{"numeroRegistro":"2026-000001"}'</i>

<i class="t-com"># 6) RN5: a devolução</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-s</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/emprestimos/1/devolucao

<i class="t-com"># 7) RN5: a mesma devolução, de novo</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-s</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/emprestimos/1/devolucao

<i class="t-com"># 8) empréstimo que não existe</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-s</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/emprestimos/99/devolucao

<i class="t-com"># 9) o exemplar voltou: pode sair de novo</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-s</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/emprestimos \
  <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">'Content-Type: application/json'</i> \
  <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">'{"numeroRegistro":"2026-000001","matricula":"2026202"}'</i></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cb cb-out">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">resposta</span><div class="cb-actions"></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="a34"><code><i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"id"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"numeroRegistro"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026-000001"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"titulo"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"Emma"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"matricula"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026101"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"emprestadoEm"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026-09-17"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"devolverAte"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026-10-01"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"devolvidoEm"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"diasDeAtraso"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">201</i><i class="t-pun">]</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"error"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"Este exemplar já está emprestado"</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">409</i><i class="t-pun">]</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"error"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"Este exemplar não está mais no acervo"</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">409</i><i class="t-pun">]</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"error"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"Exemplar não encontrado"</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">404</i><i class="t-pun">]</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"error"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"campo obrigatório: matricula"</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">400</i><i class="t-pun">]</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"id"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"numeroRegistro"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026-000001"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"titulo"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"Emma"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"matricula"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026101"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"emprestadoEm"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026-09-17"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"devolverAte"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026-10-01"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"devolvidoEm"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026-09-17"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"diasDeAtraso"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">200</i><i class="t-pun">]</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"error"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"Este empréstimo já foi devolvido"</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">409</i><i class="t-pun">]</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"error"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"Empréstimo não encontrado"</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">404</i><i class="t-pun">]</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"id"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">2</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"numeroRegistro"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026-000001"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"titulo"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"Emma"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"matricula"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026202"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"emprestadoEm"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026-09-17"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"devolverAte"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026-10-01"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"devolvidoEm"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"diasDeAtraso"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">201</i><i class="t-pun">]</i></code></pre>
</div>
<p>As datas serão as do seu ambiente. O atraso não aparece aqui — o relógio do servidor não anda catorze dias durante o teste. Quem prova o atraso, e o limite de três empréstimos, é o teste de unidade.</p>
</div>
<div class="fase-head" id="passo-17"><div class="fase-n">17</div><div class="fase-t"><h2>Checklist de entrega</h2></div></div>
<div class="fase-body">
<div class="callout"><strong>O código</strong><ol><li><code>bun x tsc --noEmit</code> sem erro.</li><li><code>bun test</code> com 35 passando e 0 falhando.</li><li><code>bun run verificar</code> dizendo “Fronteiras de módulo respeitadas”.</li><li>Os <code>curl</code> do passo 16 devolvendo os mesmos status.</li></ol></div>
<div class="callout"><strong>O desenho</strong> — é isto que vale a nota<ol><li>Nenhum arquivo de <code>src/modules/acervo</code> ou de <code>src/modules/autoria</code> importa de <code>src/modules/circulacao</code>.</li><li>A Circulação não importa nada de <code>src/modules/acervo</code> — nem a API pública. Os dois vocabulários se encontram só em <code>src/adapters/AcervoComoExemplares.ts</code>.</li><li>Nenhum caso de uso, entidade ou regra do Acervo e da Autoria foi alterado.</li><li><code>emprestimos</code> não tem chave estrangeira, e está no mapa de donos do <code>check-boundaries.ts</code>.</li><li>O que está “em aberto” é decidido por <code>Emprestimo.estaEmAberto</code>, não por SQL.</li><li>O teste de unidade não sobe servidor nem toca em arquivo <code>.sqlite</code>.</li></ol></div>
<p>O terceiro item você confere pelo próprio Git — dentro dos dois módulos antigos, só podem aparecer os dois arquivos do passo 11:</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="a35">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="a35"><code><i class="t-cmd">git</i> diff <i class="t-flag">--stat</i> src/modules/acervo src/modules/autoria</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cb cb-out">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">saída</span><div class="cb-actions"></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="a36"><code> src/modules/acervo/ConsultaDeLivros.ts                     | 4 ++++
 src/modules/acervo/infrastructure/SqliteLivroRepository.ts | 7 +++++++
 2 files changed, 11 insertions(+)</code></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>Para entregar</strong>:</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="a37">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="a37"><code><i class="t-cmd">git</i> add scripts src tests
<i class="t-cmd">git</i> commit <i class="t-flag">-m</i> <i class="t-str">"atividade 4: modulo circulacao com emprestimo e devolucao"</i></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="fase-head" id="passo-18"><div class="fase-n">18</div><div class="fase-t"><h2>Para pensar (e responder no relatório)</h2></div></div>
<div class="fase-body">
<p><strong>1.</strong> Um leitor perde o livro emprestado, e o bibliotecário dá baixa por extravio (atividade 2). O empréstimo fica em aberto para sempre, e o leitor perde uma vaga no limite. Quem deveria reagir: o Acervo, perguntando à Circulação antes de dar baixa, ou a Circulação, escutando <code>LivroBaixado</code>? Desenhe as dependências entre os módulos nos dois caminhos e escolha.</p>
<p><strong>2.</strong> Conte os arquivos que esta atividade criou para dois casos de uso e compare com a tabela “O que custou” da retrospectiva, na fase 53. A proporção se repetiu? E agora que o sistema tem três módulos e cinco pessoas diferentes poderiam mexer em cada um, esse custo já se paga?</p>
<p><strong>3.</strong> Entre conferir “o exemplar já está emprestado?” e inserir o empréstimo, outro balcão pode emprestar o mesmo exemplar. É a mesma corrida das fases 15 e 16. Por que nenhuma das camadas desta atividade resolve isso, e o que resolveria?</p>
</div>
</main>
</div>
<button class="top">↑ topo</button>
<script>
document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const cp = e.target.closest(".cp");
  if (cp) {
    const el = document.getElementById(cp.dataset.code);
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(el.innerText).then(() => {
      const t = cp.textContent; cp.textContent = "copiado!"; cp.classList.add("done");
      setTimeout(() => { cp.textContent = t; cp.classList.remove("done"); }, 1400);
    });
    return;
  }
  const tg = e.target.closest(".tgl");
  if (tg) {
    const d = document.getElementById(tg.dataset.target);
    const c = document.getElementById(tg.dataset.alt);
    const showDiff = d.hidden;
    d.hidden = !showDiff; c.hidden = showDiff;
    tg.textContent = showDiff ? "ver código final" : "ver o que mudou";
    return;
  }
  if (e.target.closest(".top")) window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Biblioteca — Aula: Postgres, Docker e React</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 viewBox=%220 0 100 100%22><text y=%22.9em%22 font-size=%2290%22>📚</text></svg>">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#f6f7f9; --card:#ffffff; --ink:#111827; --muted:#5b6472; --line:#e3e7ed;
  --accent:#1d4ed8; --accent-soft:#eef3ff; --ok:#047857; --ok-soft:#ecfdf5;
  --warn:#b45309; --warn-soft:#fffbeb; --prof:#6d28d9; --prof-soft:#f5f3ff;
  --code-bg:#0f172a; --code-ink:#e6edf7;
  --serif:"Iowan Old Style","Palatino Linotype",Palatino,Georgia,serif;
  --sans:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Inter,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  --mono:"SF Mono",SFMono-Regular,ui-monospace,"JetBrains Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:16px;line-height:1.68;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
a{color:var(--accent)}
code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.87em;background:#eef1f5;border:1px solid #e0e5ec;border-radius:4px;padding:.08em .34em;white-space:nowrap}
.ref{color:var(--muted);font-style:italic}

/* layout */
.wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:264px minmax(0,1fr);gap:0;max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto}
.side{position:sticky;top:0;align-self:start;height:100vh;overflow-y:auto;border-right:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);padding:20px 12px 60px}
.side h2{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:18px 8px 8px}
.side a{display:block;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:7px;text-decoration:none;color:#374151;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.35}
.side a:hover{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent)}
.side a.mk{font-weight:700}
.side .num{display:inline-block;min-width:26px;color:#94a3b8;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px}
main{padding:0 44px 120px;min-width:0}

/* hero */
.hero{margin:0 -44px 44px;padding:56px 44px 44px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#0f172a 0%,#1e3a8a 100%);color:#fff}
.hero .kicker{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.72;margin:0 0 12px}
.hero h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:40px;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 14px;font-weight:700}
.hero p{margin:0;max-width:70ch;opacity:.9;font-size:17px}
.hero .chips{margin-top:22px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.chip{background:rgba(255,255,255,.13);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 13px;font-size:12.5px}

/* seções */
section.doc{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:30px 34px;margin:0 0 26px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.04)}
h2.sec{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:27px;margin:0 0 6px;line-height:1.25}
h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:20px;margin:26px 0 8px}
h4{font-size:15px;margin:20px 0 6px}
h5,h6{font-size:14px;margin:16px 0 6px}
p{margin:0 0 14px}
ul,ol{margin:0 0 14px;padding-left:22px}
li{margin:0 0 5px}
blockquote{margin:0 0 16px;padding:2px 0 2px 16px;border-left:3px solid #cbd5e1;color:var(--muted)}
blockquote p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
hr{border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin:28px 0}

/* fase */
article.fase{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:0 0 30px;margin:0 0 30px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.04)}
.fase-head{padding:22px 34px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#fbfcfe;display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:flex-start}
.fase-n{flex:0 0 auto;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:19px;font-weight:700}
.fase.mk .fase-n{background:#b91c1c}
.fase-t{min-width:0}
.fase-t h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:24px;margin:0 0 4px;line-height:1.25}
.fase-t .req{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono)}
.fase-body{padding:0 34px}
.lead{margin:22px 0 4px;padding:16px 18px;background:var(--accent-soft);border:1px solid #d7e3ff;border-left:4px solid var(--accent);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;font-size:16.5px}
.lead p{margin:0}

.step{margin-top:26px}
.step > h3{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 14px;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.step.test > h3{color:var(--ok)}
.step.commit > h3{color:var(--warn)}

/* código */
.cb{margin:0 0 16px;border:1px solid #1e293b;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--code-bg)}
.cb-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 10px 6px 14px;background:#111c31;border-bottom:1px solid #1e293b}
.cb-lang{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8ba0c4}
.cb-actions{display:flex;gap:6px}
.cb button{font:inherit;font-size:11.5px;font-family:var(--sans);background:#1e293b;color:#cbd5e1;border:1px solid #33415a;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 10px;cursor:pointer}
.cb button:hover{background:#2a3a52;color:#fff}
.cb button.done{background:#065f46;border-color:#047857;color:#d1fae5}
.cb-body{margin:0;padding:14px 16px;overflow-x:auto;background:var(--code-bg)}
.cb-body code{background:none;border:0;padding:0;white-space:pre;color:var(--code-ink);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;font-family:var(--mono)}
.cb-out{border-color:#cbd5e1;background:#f8fafc}
.cb-out .cb-bar{background:#eef2f7;border-bottom-color:#dde3ec}
.cb-out .cb-lang{color:#64748b}
.cb-fig{border-style:dashed}
.cb-fig .cb-bar{background:#0d1626}
.cb-note{align-self:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#8ba0c4;opacity:.8}
.ln-new{font-weight:700;color:#fde047}
.cb-out .cb-body{background:#f8fafc}
.cb-out .cb-body code{color:#0f172a}
.cb-diff code{white-space:pre}
.dl{display:block}
.dl.add{background:rgba(16,185,129,.14);color:#a7f3d0}
.dl.del{background:rgba(239,68,68,.14);color:#fecaca}

/* tabelas */
.tw{overflow-x:auto;margin:0 0 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:14.5px}
th,td{text-align:left;padding:9px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}
th{background:#f4f6f9;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}

/* diagramas */
figure.diagram{margin:0 0 20px;padding:16px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px}
.diagram-scroll{overflow-x:auto}
svg.dg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-width:100%;min-width:520px}
figure.diagram figcaption{margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center}
.diagram.missing{color:#b91c1c;font-size:13px}

/* professor */
aside.prof{margin:18px 0;padding:16px 20px;background:var(--prof-soft);border:1px solid #ddd6fe;border-left:4px solid var(--prof);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0}
aside.prof h4{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--prof);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
aside.prof p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.conc{margin:0 0 18px;padding:0;list-style:none}
.conc li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;padding:9px 12px;background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;margin:0 0 7px;font-size:15px}
.conc li::before{content:"◆";color:var(--accent);flex:0 0 auto;font-size:11px;line-height:1.7}
.refl{padding:18px 20px;background:#fffdf5;border:1px solid #fde68a;border-left:4px solid #d97706;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0}
.refl p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

.callout{padding:16px 20px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#f8fafc;margin:0 0 18px}
.callout.good{background:var(--ok-soft);border-color:#a7f3d0}
.callout.warn{background:var(--warn-soft);border-color:#fde68a}
.entrevista{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:17.5px;line-height:1.75;background:#fffdf7;border:1px solid #e8e0cc;border-radius:12px;padding:26px 30px;position:relative}
.entrevista::before{content:"\201C";position:absolute;top:-6px;left:14px;font-size:72px;color:#e0d5b8;font-family:var(--serif);line-height:1}
.entrevista p{margin:0 0 12px;padding-left:26px}
.entrevista .quem{padding-left:26px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-style:normal}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px;margin:0 0 18px}
.stat{background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px}
.stat b{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:30px;line-height:1.1;color:var(--accent)}
.stat span{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}

footer{padding:40px 44px 60px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;text-align:center}
.top{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 16px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;opacity:.85;font-family:var(--sans)}
.top:hover{opacity:1}

@media (max-width:1020px){
  .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .side{position:static;height:auto;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);max-height:280px}
  main{padding:0 18px 80px}
  .hero{margin:0 -18px 28px;padding:36px 18px 30px}
  .hero h1{font-size:29px}
  section.doc,.fase-head,.fase-body{padding-left:18px;padding-right:18px}
}
@media print{
  .side,.top,.cb button{display:none}
  .wrap{display:block}
  body{background:#fff;font-size:11pt}
  .hero{background:#fff;color:#000;margin:0;padding:0 0 20px;border-bottom:2px solid #000}
  .hero .chip{border-color:#999;background:#f2f2f2;color:#000}
  article.fase,section.doc{break-inside:avoid-page;box-shadow:none;border-color:#ccc}
  .cb{border-color:#ccc}
  .cb-bar{background:#eee}.cb-lang{color:#333}
  .cb-note{color:#555}
  .ln-new{font-weight:700;color:#000}
  .cb-body,.cb-body code{background:#f7f7f7;color:#000}
  .dl.add{background:#e6f7ee;color:#065f46}.dl.del{background:#fdeaea;color:#991b1b}
}
/* gerar-fases:inicio */
/* tokens de código, pré-renderizados pelo gerador */
.cb-body i{font-style:normal}
.cb-body{--t-com:#64748b;--t-str:#86efac;--t-num:#fca5a5;--t-kw:#c4b5fd;
  --t-typ:#7dd3fc;--t-fn:#fdba74;--t-pun:#94a3b8;--t-key:#93c5fd;
  --t-cmd:#fdba74;--t-flag:#c4b5fd}
.cb-out .cb-body{--t-com:#64748b;--t-str:#15803d;--t-num:#b91c1c;--t-kw:#6d28d9;
  --t-typ:#0369a1;--t-fn:#b45309;--t-pun:#64748b;--t-key:#1d4ed8;
  --t-cmd:#b45309;--t-flag:#6d28d9}
.t-com{color:var(--t-com);font-style:italic}
.t-str{color:var(--t-str)}
.t-num{color:var(--t-num)}
.t-kw{color:var(--t-kw)}
.t-typ{color:var(--t-typ)}
.t-fn{color:var(--t-fn)}
.t-pun{color:var(--t-pun)}
.t-key{color:var(--t-key)}
.t-cmd{color:var(--t-cmd);font-weight:600}
.t-flag{color:var(--t-flag)}

/* linha que a fase acrescenta: negrito e fundo, por cima dos tokens.
   inline-block com min-width leva o fundo até a margem direita do bloco, para a
   marcação virar uma faixa e não um borrão do tamanho do texto */
.ln-new{display:inline-block;min-width:100%;font-weight:700;color:inherit;
  background:rgba(253,224,71,.13);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 #fde047}

<div class="hero">
  <p class="kicker">Tópicos Especiais em Engenharia de Software II · IFES</p>
  <h1>Aula — Postgres, Docker e React</h1>
  <p>O monólito modular da fase 53 sai do SQLite embutido para um <strong>Postgres 18</strong> num contêiner, isolado na rede interna do Docker. A aplicação passa ela mesma a rodar no <strong>Docker</strong> e ganha uma interface <strong>React 19</strong>, servida pela própria aplicação, para as duas features que já existem: cadastrar e buscar livros.</p>
  <div class="chips"><span class="chip">Postgres 18</span><span class="chip">Docker Compose</span><span class="chip">Bun SQL</span><span class="chip">Hono</span><span class="chip">Vite 8</span><span class="chip">React 19</span><span class="chip">React Router 7</span><span class="chip">Windows · PowerShell · VS Code</span></div>
</div>
