<pre class="cb-body" id="c44" data-file="backend/src/modules/acervo/infrastructure/PostgresLivroRepository.ts" data-step="05"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> sql <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"../../../infrastructure/postgres"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">LivroId</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">AutorId</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"../../../shared/identifiers"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">Isbn</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"../domain/Isbn"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">Livro</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"../domain/Livro"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-kw">type</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">LivroRepository</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"../domain/LivroRepository"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">NumeroRegistro</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"../domain/NumeroRegistro"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">type</i> <i class="t-typ">LivroRow</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  id<i class="t-pun">:</i> number<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  numero_registro<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  autor_id<i class="t-pun">:</i> number<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  data_catalogacao<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">};</i>

<i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">toLivro</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>row<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">LivroRow</i><i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Livro</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-fn">Livro</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
    <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-fn">LivroId</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>row<i class="t-pun">.</i>id<i class="t-pun">),</i>
    <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-fn">NumeroRegistro</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>row<i class="t-pun">.</i>numero_registro<i class="t-pun">),</i>
    <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-fn">Isbn</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>row<i class="t-pun">.</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">),</i>
    row<i class="t-pun">.</i>titulo<i class="t-pun">,</i>
    <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-fn">AutorId</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>row<i class="t-pun">.</i>autor_id<i class="t-pun">),</i>
    row<i class="t-pun">.</i>data_catalogacao<i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">);</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-com">/**</i>
<i class="t-com"> * Mesmo contrato do SqliteLivroRepository, outro banco. Os valores entram</i>
<i class="t-com"> * pelo template `sql`...`` e viram parâmetros: nunca há concatenação de SQL.</i>
<i class="t-com"> */</i>
<i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">class</i> <i class="t-typ">PostgresLivroRepository</i> <i class="t-kw">implements</i> <i class="t-typ">LivroRepository</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">contarNoAcervoDoAutor</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">AutorId</i><i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i>number<i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-com">// COUNT devolve bigint, que chega como string; ::int faz chegar number</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>row<i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`</i>
<i class="t-str">      SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total FROM livros WHERE autor_id = ${autorId.value}</i>
<i class="t-str">    `</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> number <i class="t-pun">}[];</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> row<i class="t-pun">!.</i>total<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">contarCatalogadosNoAno</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>ano<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i>number<i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>row<i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`</i>
<i class="t-str">      SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total FROM livros</i>
<i class="t-str">       WHERE data_catalogacao LIKE ${`${ano}%`}</i>
<i class="t-str">    `</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> number <i class="t-pun">}[];</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> row<i class="t-pun">!.</i>total<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">insert</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>livro<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Livro</i><i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">Livro</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>row<i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`</i>
<i class="t-str">      INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)</i>
<i class="t-str">      VALUES (${livro.numeroRegistro.value}, ${livro.isbn.value}, ${livro.titulo},</i>
<i class="t-str">              ${livro.autorId.value}, ${livro.dataCatalogacao})</i>
<i class="t-str">      RETURNING id</i>
<i class="t-str">    `</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> id<i class="t-pun">:</i> number <i class="t-pun">}[];</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> livro<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">withId</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-fn">LivroId</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>row<i class="t-pun">!.</i>id<i class="t-pun">));</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">findByIsbn</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Isbn</i><i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">Livro</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>row<i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`</i>
<i class="t-str">      SELECT * FROM livros WHERE isbn = ${isbn.value}</i>
<i class="t-str">    `</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">LivroRow</i><i class="t-pun">[];</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> row <i class="t-pun">?</i> <i class="t-fn">toLivro</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>row<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">findByAutorId</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">AutorId</i><i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">Livro</i><i class="t-pun">[]&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> rows <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`</i>
<i class="t-str">      SELECT * FROM livros WHERE autor_id = ${autorId.value}</i>
<i class="t-str">    `</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">LivroRow</i><i class="t-pun">[];</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> rows<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">map</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>toLivro<i class="t-pun">);</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">searchByTitulo</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>termo<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">Livro</i><i class="t-pun">[]&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-com">// no SQLite, LIKE ignora maiúsculas; no Postgres, não. ILIKE mantém o contrato</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> rows <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`</i>
<i class="t-str">      SELECT * FROM livros WHERE titulo ILIKE ${`%${termo}%`}</i>
<i class="t-str">    `</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">LivroRow</i><i class="t-pun">[];</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> rows<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">map</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>toLivro<i class="t-pun">);</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">findByAutorIds</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorIds<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">AutorId</i><i class="t-pun">[]):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">Livro</i><i class="t-pun">[]&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>autorIds<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">===</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-pun">[];</i>

    <i class="t-kw">const</i> ids <i class="t-pun">=</i> autorIds<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">map</i><i class="t-pun">((</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=&gt;</i> autorId<i class="t-pun">.</i>value<i class="t-pun">);</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> rows <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`</i>
<i class="t-str">      SELECT * FROM livros WHERE autor_id IN ${sql(ids)}</i>
<i class="t-str">    `</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">LivroRow</i><i class="t-pun">[];</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> rows<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">map</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>toLivro<i class="t-pun">);</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>
</code></pre>
</div>
<ul class="conc"><li><span><strong>Parâmetros, não concatenação.</strong> No template <code>sql`...${valor}...`</code>, cada <code>${}</code> vira um parâmetro da consulta (<code>$1</code>, <code>$2</code>…). O texto nunca é colado no SQL, e por isso não há injeção. É o papel que os <code>?</code> tinham no SQLite.</span></li><li><span><strong><code>COUNT(*)::int</code>.</strong> No Postgres, <code>COUNT</code> devolve <code>bigint</code>, e o Bun entrega <code>bigint</code> como <em>string</em> (<code>"5"</code>) para não perder precisão. Com o <code>::int</code>, chega um <code>number</code>, como o contrato exige.</span></li><li><span><strong><code>ILIKE</code>.</strong> No SQLite, <code>LIKE</code> ignora maiúsculas e minúsculas; no Postgres, não. Com <code>LIKE</code>, buscar “domain” deixaria de achar “Domain-Driven Design”: o código compilaria e o contrato estaria quebrado. Mesmo contrato significa mesmo <em>comportamento</em>, não só mesma assinatura.</span></li><li><span><strong><code>IN ${sql(ids)}</code>.</strong> O <code>sql(lista)</code> expande a lista em <code>($1, $2, …)</code>.</span></li></ul>
</div>
<div class="step "><h3>3 · Autoria: tabela, carga inicial e repositório</h3>
<p><strong>Edite</strong> <code>backend/src/modules/autoria/infrastructure/schema.ts</code>: só o <code>export</code> na lista de autores, para a carga do Postgres usar a mesma lista</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><span class="cb-note">backend/src/modules/autoria/infrastructure/schema.ts</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="tgl" data-target="c45-diff" data-alt="c45">ver o que mudou</button><button class="cp" data-code="c45">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c45" data-file="backend/src/modules/autoria/infrastructure/schema.ts" data-step="05"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> db <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"../../../infrastructure/db"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-com">// O id vai explícito de propósito: é ele que faz o INSERT OR IGNORE ser</i>
<i class="t-com">// idempotente, e é ele que os exemplos deste documento referenciam.</i>
<strong class="ln-new"><i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-typ">AUTORES</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i></strong>
  <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"Eric Evans"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"didatico"</i><i class="t-pun">],</i>
  <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">2</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"Robert C. Martin"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"didatico"</i><i class="t-pun">],</i>
  <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">3</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"Harper Lee"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"literatura"</i><i class="t-pun">],</i>
  <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">4</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"Jane Austen"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"literatura"</i><i class="t-pun">],</i>
<i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-kw">const</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-com">/** O módulo Autoria é o dono da tabela `autores` — e da carga inicial dela. */</i>
<i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">createAutoriaTables</i><i class="t-pun">():</i> <i class="t-kw">void</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`</i>
<i class="t-str">    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS autores (</i>
<i class="t-str">      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,</i>
<i class="t-str">      nome TEXT NOT NULL,</i>
<i class="t-str">      orcid TEXT UNIQUE,</i>
<i class="t-str">      tipo TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'literatura',</i>
<i class="t-str">      livros_no_acervo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0</i>
<i class="t-str">    );</i>
<i class="t-str">  `</i><i class="t-pun">);</i>

  <i class="t-fn">addLivrosNoAcervoIfMissing</i><i class="t-pun">();</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> insert <i class="t-pun">=</i> db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">prepare</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
    <i class="t-str">"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO autores (id, nome, tipo) VALUES (?, ?, ?)"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">);</i>

  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>id<i class="t-pun">,</i> nome<i class="t-pun">,</i> tipo<i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-kw">of</i> <i class="t-typ">AUTORES</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    insert<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>id<i class="t-pun">,</i> nome<i class="t-pun">,</i> tipo<i class="t-pun">);</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-com">/** Banco criado antes desta fase não tem a coluna — e a projeção nasce zerada. */</i>
<i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">addLivrosNoAcervoIfMissing</i><i class="t-pun">():</i> <i class="t-kw">void</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> colunas <i class="t-pun">=</i> db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"PRAGMA table_info(autores)"</i><i class="t-pun">).</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">()</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    name<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}[];</i>

  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>colunas<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">some</i><i class="t-pun">((</i>coluna<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=&gt;</i> coluna<i class="t-pun">.</i>name <i class="t-pun">===</i> <i class="t-str">"livros_no_acervo"</i><i class="t-pun">))</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
    <i class="t-str">"ALTER TABLE autores ADD COLUMN livros_no_acervo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">);</i>

  console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"Migração aplicada: coluna livros_no_acervo acrescentada a autores"</i><i class="t-pun">);</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>
</code></pre>
<pre class="cb-body cb-diff" id="c45-diff" hidden><code><span class="dl ctx"> import { db } from "../../../infrastructure/db";</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> // O id vai explícito de propósito: é ele que faz o INSERT OR IGNORE ser</span><span class="dl ctx"> // idempotente, e é ele que os exemplos deste documento referenciam.</span><span class="dl del">-const AUTORES = [</span><span class="dl add">+export const AUTORES = [</span><span class="dl ctx">   [1, "Eric Evans", "didatico"],</span><span class="dl ctx">   [2, "Robert C. Martin", "didatico"],</span><span class="dl ctx">   [3, "Harper Lee", "literatura"],</span><span class="dl ctx">   [4, "Jane Austen", "literatura"],</span><span class="dl ctx"> ] as const;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> /** O módulo Autoria é o dono da tabela `autores` — e da carga inicial dela. */</span><span class="dl ctx"> export function createAutoriaTables(): void {</span><span class="dl ctx">   db.run(`</span><span class="dl ctx">     CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS autores (</span><span class="dl ctx">       id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,</span><span class="dl ctx">       nome TEXT NOT NULL,</span><span class="dl ctx">       orcid TEXT UNIQUE,</span><span class="dl ctx">       tipo TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'literatura',</span><span class="dl ctx">       livros_no_acervo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0</span><span class="dl ctx">     );</span><span class="dl ctx">   `);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   addLivrosNoAcervoIfMissing();</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   const insert = db.prepare(</span><span class="dl ctx">     "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO autores (id, nome, tipo) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",</span><span class="dl ctx">   );</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   for (const [id, nome, tipo] of AUTORES) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     insert.run(id, nome, tipo);</span><span class="dl ctx">   }</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> /** Banco criado antes desta fase não tem a coluna — e a projeção nasce zerada. */</span><span class="dl ctx"> function addLivrosNoAcervoIfMissing(): void {</span><span class="dl ctx">   const colunas = db.query("PRAGMA table_info(autores)").all() as {</span><span class="dl ctx">     name: string;</span><span class="dl ctx">   }[];</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   if (colunas.some((coluna) =&gt; coluna.name === "livros_no_acervo")) return;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   db.run(</span><span class="dl ctx">     "ALTER TABLE autores ADD COLUMN livros_no_acervo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",</span><span class="dl ctx">   );</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   console.log("Migração aplicada: coluna livros_no_acervo acrescentada a autores");</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span></code></pre>

<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><span class="cb-note">backend/src/modules/autoria/infrastructure/postgresSchema.ts</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c46">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c46" data-file="backend/src/modules/autoria/infrastructure/postgresSchema.ts" data-step="05"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> sql <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"../../../infrastructure/postgres"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">AUTORES</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./schema"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-com">/** A mesma tabela `autores` do SQLite — e a mesma carga inicial. */</i>
<i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">createAutoriaTablesPostgres</i><i class="t-pun">():</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-kw">void</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`</i>
<i class="t-str">    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS autores (</i>
<i class="t-str">      id INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,</i>
<i class="t-str">      nome TEXT NOT NULL,</i>
<i class="t-str">      orcid TEXT UNIQUE,</i>
<i class="t-str">      tipo TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'literatura',</i>
<i class="t-str">      livros_no_acervo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0</i>
<i class="t-str">    )</i>
<i class="t-str">  `</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>id<i class="t-pun">,</i> nome<i class="t-pun">,</i> tipo<i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-kw">of</i> <i class="t-typ">AUTORES</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`</i>
<i class="t-str">      INSERT INTO autores (id, nome, tipo) VALUES (${id}, ${nome}, ${tipo})</i>
<i class="t-str">      ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING</i>
<i class="t-str">    `</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-com">// os ids da carga foram dados à mão: a sequência precisa saber, senão o</i>
  <i class="t-com">// próximo autor cadastrado tentaria o id 1 de novo</i>
  <i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`</i>
<i class="t-str">    SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('autores', 'id'), (SELECT MAX(id) FROM autores))</i>
<i class="t-str">  `</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>
</code></pre>

<pre class="cb-body" id="c47" data-file="backend/src/modules/autoria/infrastructure/PostgresAutorRepository.ts" data-step="05"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> sql <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"../../../infrastructure/postgres"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">Autor</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-kw">type</i> <i class="t-typ">TipoDeAutor</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"../domain/Autor"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-kw">type</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">ConsultaDeAutores</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">ResumoDoAutor</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"../ConsultaDeAutores"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">type</i> <i class="t-typ">AutorRow</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  id<i class="t-pun">:</i> number<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  nome<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  orcid<i class="t-pun">:</i> string <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  tipo<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  livros_no_acervo<i class="t-pun">:</i> number<i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">};</i>

<i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">toAutor</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>row<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">AutorRow</i><i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Autor</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-fn">Autor</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
    <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-fn">AutorId</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>row<i class="t-pun">.</i>id<i class="t-pun">),</i>
    row<i class="t-pun">.</i>nome<i class="t-pun">,</i>
    row<i class="t-pun">.</i>tipo <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">TipoDeAutor</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    row<i class="t-pun">.</i>livros_no_acervo<i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">);</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">class</i> <i class="t-typ">PostgresAutorRepository</i>
  <i class="t-kw">implements</i> <i class="t-typ">AutorRepository</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">ConsultaDeAutores</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">findById</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">AutorId</i><i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">Autor</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>row<i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`</i>
<i class="t-str">      SELECT * FROM autores WHERE id = ${autorId.value}</i>
<i class="t-str">    `</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">AutorRow</i><i class="t-pun">[];</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> row <i class="t-pun">?</i> <i class="t-fn">toAutor</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>row<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">resumo</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">AutorId</i><i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">ResumoDoAutor</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> autor <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-kw">this</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">findById</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">);</i>

    <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>autor <i class="t-pun">===</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      nome<i class="t-pun">:</i> autor<i class="t-pun">.</i>nome<i class="t-pun">,</i>
      tipo<i class="t-pun">:</i> autor<i class="t-pun">.</i>tipo<i class="t-pun">,</i>
      livrosNoAcervo<i class="t-pun">:</i> autor<i class="t-pun">.</i>livrosNoAcervo<i class="t-pun">,</i>
    <i class="t-pun">};</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">ajustarLivrosNoAcervo</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">AutorId</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> delta<i class="t-pun">:</i> number<i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-kw">void</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`</i>
<i class="t-str">      UPDATE autores SET livros_no_acervo = livros_no_acervo + ${delta}</i>
<i class="t-str">       WHERE id = ${autorId.value}</i>
<i class="t-str">    `</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">idsPorNome</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>termo<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">AutorId</i><i class="t-pun">[]&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> rows <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`</i>
<i class="t-str">      SELECT id FROM autores WHERE nome ILIKE ${`%${termo}%`}</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> rows<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">map</i><i class="t-pun">((</i>row<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=&gt;</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-fn">AutorId</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>row<i class="t-pun">.</i>id<i class="t-pun">));</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>
</code></pre>

<pre class="cb-body" id="c49" data-file="backend/src/modules/autoria/index.ts" data-step="05"><code><i class="t-com">/**</i>
<i class="t-com"> * API pública do módulo Autoria: um contrato de leitura, no vocabulário da</i>
<i class="t-com"> * Autoria, e a implementação que o composition root instancia. `Autor`,</i>
<i class="t-com"> * `TipoDeAutor` e `AutorRepository` deixam de ser exportados — ninguém de</i>
<i class="t-com"> * fora precisa mais deles.</i>
<i class="t-com"> */</i>
<i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">type</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">ConsultaDeAutores</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">ResumoDoAutor</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./ConsultaDeAutores"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439662"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Razão e Sensibilidade"</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439587"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Emma"</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439761"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Persuasão"</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439563"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"A Abadia de Northanger"</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141199689"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Lady Susan"</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i>
<i class="t-pun">];</i>

<strong class="ln-new"><i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-fn">createAutoriaTablesPostgres</i><i class="t-pun">();</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new"><i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-fn">createAcervoTablesPostgres</i><i class="t-pun">();</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new"><i class="t-fn">beforeEach</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">()</i> <i class="t-pun">=&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">  <i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`DELETE FROM livros`</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">importar</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>csv<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-kw">void</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">write</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"data/importacao-teste.csv"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> csv<i class="t-pun">);</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> processo <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">spawn</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
    <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-str">"bun"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"src/importar.ts"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"data/importacao-teste.csv"</i><i class="t-pun">],</i>
    <i class="t-pun">{</i> stdout<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"ignore"</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i>
  <i class="t-pun">);</i>

  <i class="t-kw">await</i> processo<i class="t-pun">.</i>exited<i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<strong class="ln-new"><i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">noAcervo</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> number<i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i>number<i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">  <i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>row<i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> sql<i class="t-str">`</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new"><i class="t-str">    SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total FROM livros WHERE autor_id = ${autorId}</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new"><i class="t-str">  `</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> number <i class="t-pun">}[];</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">  <i class="t-kw">return</i> row<i class="t-pun">!.</i>total<i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">linhasCsv</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>livros<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">typeof</i> <i class="t-typ">LIVROS</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> number<i class="t-pun">):</i> string <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>
    <i class="t-str">"isbn,titulo,autorId\n"</i> <i class="t-pun">+</i>
    livros<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">map</i><i class="t-pun">((</i>l<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=&gt;</i> <i class="t-str">`${l.isbn},${l.titulo},${autorId}`</i><i class="t-pun">).</i><i class="t-fn">join</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"\n"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">+</i>
    <i class="t-str">"\n"</i>
  <i class="t-pun">);</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-fn">test</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"RF05 também vale para a importação em lote"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">()</i> <i class="t-pun">=&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> csv <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">linhasCsv</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">LIVROS</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">AUSTEN</i><i class="t-pun">);</i>

  <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-fn">importar</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>csv<i class="t-pun">);</i>

<strong class="ln-new">  <i class="t-fn">expect</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-fn">noAcervo</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">AUSTEN</i><i class="t-pun">)).</i><i class="t-fn">toBe</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">5</i><i class="t-pun">);</i></strong>
<i class="t-pun">});</i>
</code></pre>

{</span><span class="dl del">-  db.run("DELETE FROM livros");</span><span class="dl add">+beforeEach(async () =&gt; {</span><span class="dl add">+  await sql`DELETE FROM livros`;</span><span class="dl ctx"> });</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> async function importar(csv: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {</span><span class="dl ctx">   await Bun.write("data/importacao-teste.csv", csv);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   const processo = Bun.spawn(</span><span class="dl ctx">     ["bun", "src/importar.ts", "data/importacao-teste.csv"],</span><span class="dl ctx">     { stdout: "ignore" },</span><span class="dl ctx">   );</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   await processo.exited;</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl del">-function noAcervo(autorId: number): number {</span><span class="dl del">-  const row = db</span><span class="dl del">-    .query(</span><span class="dl del">-      `SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros</span><span class="dl del">-        WHERE autor_id = ?`,</span><span class="dl del">-    )</span><span class="dl del">-    .get(autorId) as { total: number };</span><span class="dl add">+async function noAcervo(autorId: number): Promise&lt;number&gt; {</span><span class="dl add">+  const [row] = (await sql`</span><span class="dl add">+    SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total FROM livros WHERE autor_id = ${autorId}</span><span class="dl add">+  `) as { total: number }[];</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl del">-  return row.total;</span><span class="dl add">+  return row!.total;</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> function linhasCsv(livros: typeof LIVROS, autorId: number): string {</span><span class="dl ctx">   return (</span><span class="dl ctx">     "isbn,titulo,autorId\n" +</span><span class="dl ctx">     livros.map((l) =&gt; `${l.isbn},${l.titulo},${autorId}`).join("\n") +</span><span class="dl ctx">     "\n"</span><span class="dl ctx">   );</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> test("RF05 também vale para a importação em lote", async () =&gt; {</span><span class="dl ctx">   const csv = linhasCsv(LIVROS, AUSTEN);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   await importar(csv);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl del">-  expect(noAcervo(AUSTEN)).toBe(5);</span><span class="dl add">+  expect(await noAcervo(AUSTEN)).toBe(5);</span><span class="dl ctx"> });</span></code></pre>

<div class="step "><h3>7 · O compose: a aplicação encontra o banco, e os testes ganham um contêiner</h3>
<p><strong>Edite</strong> <code>compose.yaml</code>:</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">yaml</span><span class="cb-note">compose.yaml</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="tgl" data-target="c55-diff" data-alt="c55">ver o que mudou</button><button class="cp" data-code="c55">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c55" data-file="compose.yaml" data-step="05"><code><i class="t-key">services</i><i class="t-pun">:</i>
  <i class="t-key">app</i><i class="t-pun">:</i>
    <i class="t-key">build</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> .
<strong class="ln-new">    <i class="t-key">environment</i><i class="t-pun">:</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-com"># dentro da rede do compose, o banco atende pelo nome do serviço: db</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-key">DATABASE_URL</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> postgres://biblioteca:biblioteca@db:5432/biblioteca</strong>
    <i class="t-key">ports</i><i class="t-pun">:</i>
      - <i class="t-str">"3000:3000"</i>
<strong class="ln-new">    <i class="t-key">depends_on</i><i class="t-pun">:</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-key">db</i><i class="t-pun">:</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-key">condition</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> service_healthy</strong>
<strong class="ln-new"></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">  <i class="t-com"># a suíte de testes, rodando dentro da rede e contra o banco de testes:</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">  <i class="t-com"># docker compose run --rm --build test</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">  <i class="t-key">test</i><i class="t-pun">:</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">    <i class="t-key">build</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> .</strong>
<strong class="ln-new">    <i class="t-key">command</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> [<i class="t-str">"bun"</i>, <i class="t-str">"test"</i>]</strong>
<strong class="ln-new">    <i class="t-key">environment</i><i class="t-pun">:</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-key">DATABASE_URL</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> postgres://biblioteca:biblioteca@db:5432/biblioteca_test</strong>
<strong class="ln-new">    <i class="t-key">depends_on</i><i class="t-pun">:</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-key">db</i><i class="t-pun">:</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-key">condition</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> service_healthy</strong>
<strong class="ln-new">    <i class="t-com"># com um profile, o "docker compose up" não sobe este serviço</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">    <i class="t-key">profiles</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> [<i class="t-str">"test"</i>]</strong>

  <i class="t-key">db</i><i class="t-pun">:</i>
    <i class="t-key">image</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> postgres:18
    <i class="t-key">environment</i><i class="t-pun">:</i>
      <i class="t-key">POSTGRES_USER</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> biblioteca
      <i class="t-key">POSTGRES_PASSWORD</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> biblioteca
      <i class="t-key">POSTGRES_DB</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> biblioteca
    <i class="t-com"># sem "ports": o banco não fica exposto no seu computador, só os outros</i>
    <i class="t-com"># serviços deste compose.yaml o enxergam, pela rede interna do Docker</i>
    <i class="t-key">volumes</i><i class="t-pun">:</i>
      <i class="t-com"># a partir do Postgres 18 o volume é montado em /var/lib/postgresql</i>
      <i class="t-com"># (e não mais em /var/lib/postgresql/data)</i>
      - <i class="t-key">pgdata</i><i class="t-pun">:</i>/var/lib/postgresql
    <i class="t-key">healthcheck</i><i class="t-pun">:</i>
      <i class="t-key">test</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> [<i class="t-str">"CMD-SHELL"</i>, <i class="t-str">"pg_isready -h localhost -U biblioteca -d biblioteca"</i>]
      <i class="t-key">interval</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> 2s
      <i class="t-key">timeout</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> 3s
      <i class="t-key">retries</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> 15

<i class="t-key">volumes</i><i class="t-pun">:</i>
  <i class="t-key">pgdata</i><i class="t-pun">:</i>
</code></pre>
<pre class="cb-body cb-diff" id="c55-diff" hidden><code><span class="dl ctx"> services:</span><span class="dl ctx">   app:</span><span class="dl ctx">     build: .</span><span class="dl add">+    environment:</span><span class="dl add">+      # dentro da rede do compose, o banco atende pelo nome do serviço: db</span><span class="dl add">+      DATABASE_URL: postgres://biblioteca:biblioteca@db:5432/biblioteca</span><span class="dl ctx">     ports:</span><span class="dl ctx">       - "3000:3000"</span><span class="dl add">+    depends_on:</span><span class="dl add">+      db:</span><span class="dl add">+        condition: service_healthy</span><span class="dl add">+</span><span class="dl add">+  # a suíte de testes, rodando dentro da rede e contra o banco de testes:</span><span class="dl add">+  # docker compose run --rm --build test</span><span class="dl add">+  test:</span><span class="dl add">+    build: .</span><span class="dl add">+    command: ["bun", "test"]</span><span class="dl add">+    environment:</span><span class="dl add">+      DATABASE_URL: postgres://biblioteca:biblioteca@db:5432/biblioteca_test</span><span class="dl add">+    depends_on:</span><span class="dl add">+      db:</span><span class="dl add">+        condition: service_healthy</span><span class="dl add">+    # com um profile, o "docker compose up" não sobe este serviço</span><span class="dl add">+    profiles: ["test"]</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   db:</span><span class="dl ctx">     image: postgres:18</span><span class="dl ctx">     environment:</span><span class="dl ctx">       POSTGRES_USER: biblioteca</span><span class="dl ctx">       POSTGRES_PASSWORD: biblioteca</span><span class="dl ctx">       POSTGRES_DB: biblioteca</span><span class="dl ctx">     # sem "ports": o banco não fica exposto no seu computador, só os outros</span><span class="dl ctx">     # serviços deste compose.yaml o enxergam, pela rede interna do Docker</span><span class="dl ctx">     volumes:</span><span class="dl ctx">       # a partir do Postgres 18 o volume é montado em /var/lib/postgresql</span><span class="dl ctx">       # (e não mais em /var/lib/postgresql/data)</span><span class="dl ctx">       - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql</span><span class="dl ctx">     healthcheck:</span><span class="dl ctx">       test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -h localhost -U biblioteca -d biblioteca"]</span><span class="dl ctx">       interval: 2s</span><span class="dl ctx">       timeout: 3s</span><span class="dl ctx">       retries: 15</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> volumes:</span><span class="dl ctx">   pgdata:</span></code></pre>
</div>
<ul class="conc"><li><span><strong><code>@db:5432</code>, não <code>@localhost</code>.</strong> Dentro de um contêiner, <code>localhost</code> é o próprio contêiner. Na rede que o Compose cria, cada serviço atende pelo nome: o banco é <code>db</code>. No Windows, <code>localhost:5432</code> seria o <em>seu</em> PostgreSQL, se houver um, e não este.</span></li><li><span><strong><code>depends_on</code> com <code>service_healthy</code>.</strong> A aplicação só sobe depois que o healthcheck do banco passa, e não apenas depois que o contêiner do banco foi criado.</span></li><li><span><strong>O serviço <code>test</code></strong> usa a mesma imagem, mas roda <code>bun test</code> e aponta para o <code>biblioteca_test</code>. O <code>profiles</code> faz o <code>docker compose up</code> ignorá-lo: ele só roda quando chamado pelo nome.</span></li></ul>
</div>
<div class="step test"><h3>Verifique</h3>
<p>No Windows, em <code>backend/</code>, rode o que não precisa de banco: o compilador, o verificador e os testes de <em>unidade</em>, que usam dublês em memória:</p>
<div class="cb"><div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><span class="cb-note">PowerShell</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c56">copiar</button></div></div><pre class="cb-body" id="c56"><code><i class="t-cmd">bun</i> run typecheck
<i class="t-cmd">bun</i> run verificar
<i class="t-cmd">bun</i> test tests/cadastrar-livro.test.ts</code></pre></div>
<div class="cb cb-out"><div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">saída esperada</span></div><pre class="cb-body" id="c57"><code>$ tsc --noEmit
$ bun scripts/check-boundaries.ts
Fronteiras de módulo respeitadas.
 8 pass
 0 fail
 11 expect() calls
Ran 8 tests across 1 file.</code></pre></div>
<div class="callout "><strong>E o <code>bun test</code> sem nada depois?</strong> No Windows, os testes de integração vão falhar com <em>DATABASE_URL não definida: o banco só existe na rede do Docker</em>. É o esperado: eles precisam do banco, e o banco está na rede interna. Eles rodam no contêiner de testes, abaixo.</div>
<p>A suíte completa, dentro da rede. Na raiz:</p>
<div class="cb"><div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><span class="cb-note">PowerShell</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c58">copiar</button></div></div><pre class="cb-body" id="c58"><code><i class="t-cmd">docker</i> compose run <i class="t-flag">--rm</i> <i class="t-flag">--build</i> test</code></pre></div>
<div class="cb cb-out"><div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">saída (final)</span></div><pre class="cb-body" id="c59"><code> 11 pass
 0 fail
 29 expect() calls
Ran 11 tests across 3 files.</code></pre></div>
<p>O <code>--build</code> refaz a imagem com o código atual, e o <code>--rm</code> apaga o contêiner de testes ao final. Os mesmos 11 testes de sempre, agora contra o Postgres. Por fim, recrie a aplicação com o código novo e cadastre o livro de novo, porque o do passo 04 ficou no SQLite que foi embora:</p>
<div class="cb"><div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><span class="cb-note">PowerShell</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c60">copiar</button></div></div><pre class="cb-body" id="c60"><code><i class="t-cmd">docker</i> compose up <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-flag">--build</i> app
<i class="t-cmd">Invoke-RestMethod</i> <i class="t-flag">-Method</i> Post <i class="t-flag">-Uri</i> http://localhost:3000/livros <i class="t-flag">-ContentType</i> "application/json<i class="t-pun">; </i><i class="t-cmd">charset=utf-8"</i> <i class="t-flag">-Body</i> <i class="t-str">'{"isbn":"9780321125217","titulo":"Domain-Driven Design","autorId":1}'</i></code></pre></div>
<p>Abra <a href="http://localhost:3000/livros/domain">http://localhost:3000/livros/domain</a> (em minúsculas, para testar o <code>ILIKE</code>) e <a href="http://localhost:3000/livros/evans">http://localhost:3000/livros/evans</a>. Confira o registro direto no Postgres:</p>
<div class="cb"><div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><span class="cb-note">PowerShell</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c61">copiar</button></div></div><pre class="cb-body" id="c61"><code><i class="t-cmd">docker</i> compose exec db psql <i class="t-flag">-U</i> biblioteca <i class="t-flag">-d</i> biblioteca <i class="t-flag">-c</i> <i class="t-str">"select numero_registro, isbn, titulo from livros;"</i></code></pre></div>
<p>Agora o livro sobrevive à recriação do contêiner da aplicação, porque está no volume do banco. Recrie o contêiner e abra de novo <a href="http://localhost:3000/livros/evans">/livros/evans</a>:</p>
<div class="cb"><div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><span class="cb-note">PowerShell</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c62">copiar</button></div></div><pre class="cb-body" id="c62"><code><i class="t-cmd">docker</i> compose up <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-flag">--force-recreate</i> app</code></pre></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="fase-head" id="passo-06"><div class="fase-n">06</div><div class="fase-t"><h2>O frontend nasce com o Vite</h2></div></div>
<div class="fase-body">
<p>O <strong>Vite</strong> monta o projeto React com TypeScript e serve tudo em desenvolvimento com recarga instantânea. Na hora da entrega, ele gera os arquivos estáticos (HTML, JS, CSS) que o backend vai servir. O frontend não fala com o banco, então roda direto no Windows.</p>
<div class="step "><h3>Crie o projeto</h3>
<p>Na <strong>raiz</strong> do repositório:</p>
<div class="cb"><div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><span class="cb-note">PowerShell</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c63">copiar</button></div></div><pre class="cb-body" id="c63"><code><i class="t-cmd">bunx</i> create-vite@9.2.1 frontend <i class="t-flag">--template</i> react-ts <i class="t-flag">--no-interactive</i>
<i class="t-cmd">cd</i> frontend
<i class="t-cmd">bun</i> install
<i class="t-cmd">bun</i> add react-router-dom</code></pre></div>
<p>O <code>--no-interactive</code> evita as perguntas do assistente: o template <code>react-ts</code> já diz tudo. A versão do <em>gerador</em> (<code>create-vite@9.2.1</code>) é fixa para os arquivos do template serem exatamente os que o passo 08 apaga. As bibliotecas, essas, entram na versão mais nova. Confira em <code>frontend/package.json</code>: React 19, Vite 8 e <code>react-router-dom</code> 7.</p>
<div class="callout "><strong>Por que <code>react-router-dom</code> 7, se existe React Router 8?</strong> A partir da versão 7, o <code>react-router-dom</code> só repassa o que vem do pacote <code>react-router</code>. A linha 8 é publicada apenas como <code>react-router</code>, e o <code>react-router-dom</code> ficou na 7. A API que usamos aqui (<code>BrowserRouter</code>, <code>Routes</code>, <code>NavLink</code>, <code>useSearchParams</code>) é a mesma nas duas.</div>
</div>
<div class="step test"><h3>Verifique</h3>
<div class="cb"><div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><span class="cb-note">PowerShell</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c64">copiar</button></div></div><pre class="cb-body" id="c64"><code><i class="t-cmd">bun</i> run dev</code></pre></div>
<p>Abra <a href="http://localhost:5173">http://localhost:5173</a>: deve aparecer a página de exemplo do Vite com React. Pare com <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="fase-head" id="passo-07"><div class="fase-n">07</div><div class="fase-t"><h2>A API muda para /api</h2></div></div>
<div class="fase-body">
<p>O frontend e a API vão morar no <strong>mesmo endereço</strong> (<code>http://localhost:3000</code>). Se a API continuasse em <code>/livros/...</code>, ela disputaria endereços com as páginas do React. A convenção mais simples é pôr a API inteira sob um prefixo, <code>/api</code>, e deixar o resto para o frontend.</p>
<div class="step "><h3>1 · O backend</h3>
<p><strong>Edite</strong> <code>backend/src/server.ts</code>: as rotas passam a ser registradas num sub-app montado em <code>/api</code>. Os erros lançados lá dentro continuam caindo no <code>onError</code> do app principal</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><span class="cb-note">backend/src/server.ts</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="tgl" data-target="c65-diff" data-alt="c65">ver o que mudou</button><button class="cp" data-code="c65">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c65" data-file="backend/src/server.ts" data-step="07"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">Hono</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"hono"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-kw">type</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">UseCases</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./composition"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> registerRoutes <i class="t-kw">as</i> registerAcervo <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./modules/acervo"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">InvalidInput</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">NotFound</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">RuleConflict</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./shared/errors"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">errorResponse</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>error<i class="t-pun">:</i> unknown<i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>error <i class="t-kw">instanceof</i> <i class="t-typ">InvalidInput</i> <i class="t-pun">||</i> error <i class="t-kw">instanceof</i> <i class="t-typ">InvalidValue</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">({</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> error<i class="t-pun">.</i>message <i class="t-pun">},</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">400</i> <i class="t-pun">});</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>error <i class="t-kw">instanceof</i> <i class="t-typ">NotFound</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">({</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> error<i class="t-pun">.</i>message <i class="t-pun">},</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">});</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>error <i class="t-kw">instanceof</i> <i class="t-typ">RuleConflict</i> <i class="t-pun">||</i> error <i class="t-kw">instanceof</i> <i class="t-typ">DomainError</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">({</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> error<i class="t-pun">.</i>message <i class="t-pun">},</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">});</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">error</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>error<i class="t-pun">);</i>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">({</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Erro interno"</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">500</i> <i class="t-pun">});</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">createServer</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>useCases<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">UseCases</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> porta <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">Number</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>process<i class="t-pun">.</i>env<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-typ">PORT</i> <i class="t-pun">??</i> <i class="t-num">3000</i><i class="t-pun">))</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
<strong class="ln-new">  <i class="t-kw">const</i> api <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-fn">Hono</i><i class="t-pun">();</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new"></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">  api<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>contexto<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=&gt;</i> contexto<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">({</i> message<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"API da Biblioteca"</i> <i class="t-pun">}));</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new"></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">  <i class="t-fn">registerAcervo</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>api<i class="t-pun">,</i> useCases<i class="t-pun">);</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new"></strong>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> app <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-fn">Hono</i><i class="t-pun">();</i>

<strong class="ln-new">  <i class="t-com">// toda a API mora sob /api: o resto dos endereços fica livre para o frontend</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">  app<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">route</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/api"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> api<i class="t-pun">);</i></strong>

  app<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">notFound</i><i class="t-pun">((</i>contexto<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=&gt;</i>
    contexto<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">({</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Recurso não encontrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i> <i class="t-num">404</i><i class="t-pun">),</i>
  <i class="t-pun">);</i>

  app<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">onError</i><i class="t-pun">((</i>error<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=&gt;</i> <i class="t-fn">errorResponse</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>error<i class="t-pun">));</i>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">serve</i><i class="t-pun">({</i> port<i class="t-pun">:</i> porta<i class="t-pun">,</i> fetch<i class="t-pun">:</i> app<i class="t-pun">.</i>fetch <i class="t-pun">});</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i></code></pre>
<pre class="cb-body cb-diff" id="c65-diff" hidden><code><span class="dl ctx"> import { Hono } from "hono";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import type { UseCases } from "./composition";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import { DomainError, InvalidValue } from "./shared/domain-errors";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import { registerRoutes as registerAcervo } from "./modules/acervo";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import { InvalidInput, NotFound, RuleConflict } from "./shared/errors";</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> function errorResponse(error: unknown): Response {</span><span class="dl ctx">   if (error instanceof InvalidInput || error instanceof InvalidValue) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });</span><span class="dl ctx">   }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   if (error instanceof NotFound) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 404 });</span><span class="dl ctx">   }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   if (error instanceof RuleConflict || error instanceof DomainError) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 409 });</span><span class="dl ctx">   }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   console.error(error);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   return Response.json({ error: "Erro interno" }, { status: 500 });</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> export function createServer(useCases: UseCases, porta = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000)) {</span><span class="dl add">+  const api = new Hono();</span><span class="dl add">+</span><span class="dl add">+  api.get("/", (contexto) =&gt; contexto.json({ message: "API da Biblioteca" }));</span><span class="dl add">+</span><span class="dl add">+  registerAcervo(api, useCases);</span><span class="dl add">+</span><span class="dl ctx">   const app = new Hono();</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl del">-  app.get("/", (contexto) =&gt; contexto.json({ message: "API da Biblioteca" }));</span><span class="dl del">-</span><span class="dl del">-  registerAcervo(app, useCases);</span><span class="dl add">+  // toda a API mora sob /api: o resto dos endereços fica livre para o frontend</span><span class="dl add">+  app.route("/api", api);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   app.notFound((contexto) =&gt;</span><span class="dl ctx">     contexto.json({ error: "Recurso não encontrado" }, 404),</span><span class="dl ctx">   );</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   app.onError((error) =&gt; errorResponse(error));</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   return Bun.serve({ port: porta, fetch: app.fetch });</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span></code></pre>

    <i class="t-kw">const</i> livro <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> useCases<i class="t-pun">.</i>cadastrarLivro<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">execute</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>

    <i class="t-pun">);</i>

<strong class="ln-new">    contexto<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">header</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"Location"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">`/api/livros/${livro.isbn}`</i><i class="t-pun">);</i></strong>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> contexto<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>livro<i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">201</i><i class="t-pun">);</i>
  <i class="t-pun">});</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>
</code></pre>
<pre class="cb-body cb-diff" id="c66-diff" hidden><code><span class="dl ctx"> import type { Hono } from "hono";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import type { UseCases } from "../../../../composition";</span><span class="dl ctx"> import { parseNovoLivro } from "./input";</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> export function register(routes: Hono, useCases: UseCases): void {</span><span class="dl ctx">   routes.post("/livros", async (contexto) =&gt; {</span><span class="dl ctx">     const livro = await useCases.cadastrarLivro.execute(</span><span class="dl ctx">       parseNovoLivro(await contexto.req.json()),</span><span class="dl ctx">     );</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl del">-    contexto.header("Location", `/livros/${livro.isbn}`);</span><span class="dl add">+    contexto.header("Location", `/api/livros/${livro.isbn}`);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">     return contexto.json(livro, 201);</span><span class="dl ctx">   });</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span></code></pre>

<pre class="cb-body" id="c67" data-file="backend/tests/cadastro.e2e.test.ts" data-step="07"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> afterAll<i class="t-pun">,</i> beforeAll<i class="t-pun">,</i> beforeEach<i class="t-pun">,</i> expect<i class="t-pun">,</i> test <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"bun:test"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-typ">BASE</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-str">"http://localhost:3999"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-typ">LIVROS</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>

  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439662"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Razão e Sensibilidade"</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439587"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Emma"</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439761"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Persuasão"</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439563"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"A Abadia de Northanger"</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141199689"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Lady Susan"</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i>
<i class="t-pun">];</i>

<i class="t-com">/** ISBN-13 sintético com dígito verificador correto — a fase 34 vai conferir. */</i>
<i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">isbnSintetico</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>seq<i class="t-pun">:</i> number<i class="t-pun">):</i> string <i class="t-pun">{</i>

  <i class="t-kw">let</i> soma <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">let</i> i <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> i <i class="t-pun">&lt;</i> <i class="t-num">12</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> i<i class="t-pun">++)</i> soma <i class="t-pun">+=</i> <i class="t-fn">Number</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>doze<i class="t-pun">[</i>i<i class="t-pun">]!)</i> <i class="t-pun">*</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>i <i class="t-pun">%</i> <i class="t-num">2</i> <i class="t-pun">===</i> <i class="t-num">0</i> <i class="t-pun">?</i> <i class="t-num">1</i> <i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">3</i><i class="t-pun">);</i>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> doze <i class="t-pun">+</i> <i class="t-pun">((</i><i class="t-num">10</i> <i class="t-pun">-</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>soma <i class="t-pun">%</i> <i class="t-num">10</i><i class="t-pun">))</i> <i class="t-pun">%</i> <i class="t-num">10</i><i class="t-pun">);</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-typ">LIVROS_DE_EVANS</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Array</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">from</i><i class="t-pun">({</i> length<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">11</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>_<i class="t-pun">,</i> i<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">({</i>

<i class="t-kw">let</i> server<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">ReturnType</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-kw">typeof</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i>spawn<i class="t-pun">&gt;;</i>

<i class="t-pun">});</i>

    <i class="t-fn">expect</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>response<i class="t-pun">.</i>status<i class="t-pun">).</i><i class="t-fn">toBe</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">201</i><i class="t-pun">);</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> decimoPrimeiro <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-fn">cadastrarDeEvans</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">10</i><i class="t-pun">);</i>

  <i class="t-fn">expect</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>decimoPrimeiro<i class="t-pun">.</i>status<i class="t-pun">).</i><i class="t-fn">toBe</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">409</i><i class="t-pun">);</i>
<i class="t-pun">});</i></code></pre>

({</span><span class="dl ctx">   isbn: isbnSintetico(i),</span><span class="dl ctx">   titulo: `Título didático ${i + 1}`,</span><span class="dl ctx"> }));</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> let server: ReturnType&lt;typeof Bun.spawn&gt;;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> beforeAll(async () =&gt; {</span><span class="dl ctx">   server.kill();</span><span class="dl ctx"> });</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> beforeEach(async () =&gt; {</span><span class="dl ctx">   // ... e sem limpar o banco de verdade entre um teste e outro</span><span class="dl ctx">   await sql`DELETE FROM livros`;</span><span class="dl ctx"> });</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> function cadastrar(n: number, autorId = AUSTEN, livros = LIVROS) {</span><span class="dl del">-  return fetch(`${BASE}/livros`, {</span><span class="dl add">+  return fetch(`${BASE}/api/livros`, {</span><span class="dl ctx">     method: "POST",</span><span class="dl ctx">     headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },</span><span class="dl ctx">     body: JSON.stringify({ ...livros[n], autorId }),</span><span class="dl ctx">   });</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> const cadastrarDeEvans = (n: number) =&gt; <div class="step "><h3>2 · O proxy do Vite</h3>
<p>Em desenvolvimento são dois servidores: o Vite (5173), rodando no Windows, serve a interface; o contêiner <code>app</code> (3000) serve a API. Com o <strong>proxy</strong>, o navegador faz tudo em <code>localhost:5173</code>, e o Vite repassa ao contêiner o que começa com <code>/api</code>. Assim o código React chama <code>/api/livros</code> sem saber em que porta a API está, e isso continua valendo quando tudo for servido pelo mesmo app.</p>
<p><strong>Substitua todo o conteúdo</strong> de <code>frontend/vite.config.ts</code>:</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><span class="cb-note">frontend/vite.config.ts</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c68">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c68" data-file="frontend/vite.config.ts" data-step="07"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> react <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"@vitejs/plugin-react"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> defineConfig <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"vite"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-com">// https://vite.dev/config/</i>
<i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">default</i> <i class="t-fn">defineConfig</i><i class="t-pun">({</i>
  plugins<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-fn">react</i><i class="t-pun">()],</i>
  server<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-com">// em desenvolvimento, o Vite (porta 5173) repassa /api para o backend (porta 3000)</i>
    proxy<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-str">"/api"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"http://localhost:3000"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    <i class="t-pun">},</i>
  <i class="t-pun">},</i>
<i class="t-pun">});</i>
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="step test"><h3>Verifique</h3>
<p>O backend mudou, então a imagem precisa ser refeita. Na raiz:</p>
<div class="cb"><div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><span class="cb-note">PowerShell</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c69">copiar</button></div></div><pre class="cb-body" id="c69"><code><i class="t-cmd">docker</i> compose run <i class="t-flag">--rm</i> <i class="t-flag">--build</i> test
<i class="t-cmd">docker</i> compose up <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-flag">--build</i> app</code></pre></div>
<div class="cb cb-out"><div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">saída esperada</span></div><pre class="cb-body" id="c70"><code> 11 pass
 0 fail
 29 expect() calls
Ran 11 tests across 3 files.</code></pre></div>
<p><a href="http://localhost:3000/api">http://localhost:3000/api</a> responde <code>{"message":"API da Biblioteca"}</code>, e <a href="http://localhost:3000/api/livros/evans">/api/livros/evans</a> devolve o livro. O endereço antigo, <code>/livros/evans</code>, agora dá 404.</p>
<div class="callout "><strong>O ciclo do backend, daqui em diante:</strong> mudou código em <code>backend/</code>? Rode <code>docker compose up -d --build app</code> para a mudança chegar ao contêiner, e <code>docker compose run --rm --build test</code> para os testes.</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="fase-head" id="passo-08"><div class="fase-n">08</div><div class="fase-t"><h2>As telas: cadastrar e buscar</h2></div></div>
<div class="fase-body">
<p>Duas páginas e um menu, sem biblioteca de componentes: só React, React Router e CSS puro. As regras de negócio continuam todas no backend, e o frontend só mostra o que ele responde.</p>
<div class="step "><h3>1 · Limpe o exemplo do template</h3>
<p>Em <code>frontend/</code>:</p>

<div class="step "><h3>2 · O cliente da API</h3>
<p><strong>Crie</strong> <code>frontend/src/api.ts</code>: o único arquivo do frontend que sabe que a API existe</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><span class="cb-note">frontend/src/api.ts</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c73">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c73" data-file="frontend/src/api.ts" data-step="08"><code><i class="t-com">/** O que a API devolve para cada livro (o LivroJson do backend). */</i>
<i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">type</i> <i class="t-typ">Livro</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  id<i class="t-pun">:</i> number<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  autor<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  livrosDoAutor<i class="t-pun">:</i> number<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  dataCatalogacao<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">};</i>

<i class="t-com">/** O que a API espera para cadastrar um livro. */</i>
<i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">type</i> <i class="t-typ">NovoLivro</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">;</i>
  autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> number<i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">};</i>

<i class="t-com">/** Lê o JSON da resposta. Se a API recusou, lança o { error } que ela mandou. */</i>
<i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-kw">function</i> lerJson<i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">T</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;(</i>resposta<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">T</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> corpo <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> resposta<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">().</i><i class="t-kw">catch</i><i class="t-pun">(()</i> <i class="t-pun">=&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">({}));</i>

  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(!</i>resposta<i class="t-pun">.</i>ok<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">throw</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-fn">Error</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>corpo<i class="t-pun">.</i>error <i class="t-pun">??</i> <i class="t-str">`Erro ${resposta.status}`</i><i class="t-pun">);</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> corpo <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">T</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">buscarLivros</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>termo<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">Livro</i><i class="t-pun">[]&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> resposta <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`/api/livros/${encodeURIComponent(termo)}`</i><i class="t-pun">);</i>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> lerJson<i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">Livro</i><i class="t-pun">[]&gt;(</i>resposta<i class="t-pun">);</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">cadastrarLivro</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>livro<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">NovoLivro</i><i class="t-pun">):</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">Livro</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> resposta <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/api/livros"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"POST"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    headers<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-str">"Content-Type"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"application/json"</i> <i class="t-pun">},</i>
    body<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">JSON</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">stringify</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>livro<i class="t-pun">),</i>
  <i class="t-pun">});</i>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> lerJson<i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">Livro</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;(</i>resposta<i class="t-pun">);</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-com">/** "2026-10-01" → "01/10/2026", sem passar por Date (e sem erro de fuso). */</i>
<i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">formatarData</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>iso<i class="t-pun">:</i> string<i class="t-pun">):</i> string <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">return</i> iso<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"-"</i><i class="t-pun">).</i><i class="t-fn">reverse</i><i class="t-pun">().</i><i class="t-fn">join</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">);</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>
</code></pre>
</div>
<p>O <code>lerJson</code> transforma qualquer resposta de erro da API (400, 404, 409) numa exceção com a mensagem que o backend mandou, como <em>“Livro já cadastrado”</em> ou <em>“O autor já tem 5 livros no acervo”</em>.</p>
</div>

  <i class="t-pun">&lt;/</i><i class="t-typ">StrictMode</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;,</i>
<i class="t-pun">);</i>
</code></pre>

<pre class="cb-body" id="c75" data-file="frontend/src/App.tsx" data-step="08"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">NavLink</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">Route</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">Routes</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"react-router-dom"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
