<strong class="ln-new">    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>_request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livros <i class="t-pun">=</i> db</strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>params<i class="t-pun">.</i>q<i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>livros<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> server <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">serve</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i>
  port<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">3000</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> url <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">URL</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">.</i>url<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> route <i class="t-kw">of</i> routes<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>method <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i>method<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> params <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">,</i> url<i class="t-pun">.</i>pathname<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> route<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">handler</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Recurso não encontrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>

Response.json({ message: "API da Biblioteca" }),</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx">   {</span><span class="dl del">-    // rota descartável: existe só para provarmos a captura de parâmetros.</span><span class="dl del">-    // Some na fase 10, quando a primeira rota de verdade com parâmetro chegar.</span><span class="dl del">-    method: "GET",</span><span class="dl del">-    pattern: "/eco/:mensagem",</span><span class="dl del">-    handler: (_request, params) =&gt; Response.json({ eco: params.mensagem }),</span><span class="dl del">-  },</span><span class="dl del">-  {</span><span class="dl ctx">     method: "POST",</span><span class="dl ctx">     pattern: "/livros",</span><span class="dl ctx">     handler: async (request) =&gt; {</span><span class="dl ctx">       const body = (await request.json()) as {</span><span class="dl ctx">         isbn: string;</span><span class="dl ctx">         titulo: string;</span><span class="dl ctx">         autorId: number;</span><span class="dl ctx">         numeroRegistro: string;</span><span class="dl ctx">         dataCatalogacao: string;</span><span class="dl ctx">       };</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       const result = db.run(</span><span class="dl ctx">         `INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)</span><span class="dl ctx">          VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,</span><span class="dl ctx">         [body.numeroRegistro, body.isbn, body.titulo, body.autorId, body.dataCatalogacao],</span><span class="dl ctx">       );</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       const livro = db</span><span class="dl ctx">         .query("SELECT * FROM livros WHERE id = ?")</span><span class="dl ctx">         .get(result.lastInsertRowid as number);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       return Response.json(livro, { status: 201 });</span><span class="dl ctx">     },</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl add">+  {</span><span class="dl add">+    method: "GET",</span><span class="dl add">+    pattern: "/livros/:q",</span><span class="dl add">+    handler: (_request, params) =&gt; {</span><span class="dl add">+      const livros = db</span><span class="dl add">+        .query("SELECT * FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?")</span><span class="dl add">+        .all(params.q!);</span><span class="dl add">+</span><span class="dl add">+      return Response.json(livros);</span><span class="dl add">+    },</span><span class="dl add">+  },</span><span class="dl ctx"> ];</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> const server = Bun.serve({</span><span class="dl ctx">   port: 3000,</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   async fetch(request) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     const url = new URL(request.url);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">     for (const route of routes) {</span><span class="dl ctx">       if (route.method !== request.method) continue;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       const params = match(route.pattern, url.pathname);</span><span class="dl ctx">       if (params) return await route.handler(request, params);</span><span class="dl ctx">     }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">     return Response.json({ error: "Recurso não encontrado" }, { status: 404 });</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx"> });</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> console.log(`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`);</span></code></pre>

  <div class="fase-t"><h2>a busca ganha título e autor</h2><div class="req">Requisitos: RF03</div></div>

Você vai perceber que está copiando o bloco anterior e trocando as palavras, duas vezes. <strong>Copie mesmo.</strong> É esse o ponto.</p></div>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> params<i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> routes<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Route</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> message<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"API da Biblioteca"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"POST"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> body <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        dataCatalogacao<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> result <i class="t-pun">=</i> db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
        <i class="t-str">`INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">[</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>titulo<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>dataCatalogacao<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
      <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livro <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>result<i class="t-pun">.</i>lastInsertRowid <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>livro<i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">201</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros/:q"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>_request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> q <i class="t-pun">=</i> params<i class="t-pun">.</i>q<i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porIsbn <i class="t-pun">=</i> db</strong>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>q<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porTitulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> db</strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE titulo LIKE ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db</strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">          <i class="t-str">`SELECT livros.* FROM livros</i></strong><i class="t-str">
</i><strong class="ln-new"><i class="t-str">             JOIN autores ON autores.id = livros.autor_id</i></strong><i class="t-str">
</i><strong class="ln-new"><i class="t-str">            WHERE autores.nome LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">)</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porAutor<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> server <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">serve</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i>
  port<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">3000</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> url <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">URL</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">.</i>url<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> route <i class="t-kw">of</i> routes<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>method <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i>method<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> params <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">,</i> url<i class="t-pun">.</i>pathname<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> route<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">handler</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Recurso não encontrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>
<pre class="cb-body cb-diff" id="c413-diff" hidden><code><span class="dl ctx"> import { db, createDb } from "./db";</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> createDb();</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> type Handler = (</span><span class="dl ctx">   request: Request,</span><span class="dl ctx">   params: Record&lt;string, string&gt;,</span><span class="dl ctx"> ) =&gt; Response | Promise&lt;Response&gt;;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> type Route = { method: string; pattern: string; handler: Handler };</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> function match(pattern: string, path: string): Record&lt;string, string&gt; | null {</span><span class="dl ctx">   const patternParts = pattern.split("/").filter(Boolean);</span><span class="dl ctx">   const pathParts = path.split("/").filter(Boolean);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   if (patternParts.length !== pathParts.length) return null;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   const params: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {};</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   for (let i = 0; i &lt; patternParts.length; i++) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     const expected = patternParts[i]!;</span><span class="dl ctx">     const received = pathParts[i]!;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">     if (expected.startsWith(":")) {</span><span class="dl ctx">       params[expected.slice(1)] = received;</span><span class="dl ctx">     } else if (expected !== received) {</span><span class="dl ctx">       return null;</span><span class="dl ctx">     }</span><span class="dl ctx">   }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   return params;</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> const routes: Route[] = [</span><span class="dl ctx">   {</span><span class="dl ctx">     method: "GET",</span><span class="dl ctx">     pattern: "/",</span><span class="dl ctx">     handler: () =&gt; Response.json({ message: "API da Biblioteca" }),</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx">   {</span><span class="dl ctx">     method: "POST",</span><span class="dl ctx">     pattern: "/livros",</span><span class="dl ctx">     handler: async (request) =&gt; {</span><span class="dl ctx">       const body = (await request.json()) as {</span><span class="dl ctx">         isbn: string;</span><span class="dl ctx">         titulo: string;</span><span class="dl ctx">         autorId: number;</span><span class="dl ctx">         numeroRegistro: string;</span><span class="dl ctx">         dataCatalogacao: string;</span><span class="dl ctx">       };</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       const result = db.run(</span><span class="dl ctx">         `INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)</span><span class="dl ctx">          VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,</span><span class="dl ctx">         [body.numeroRegistro, body.isbn, body.titulo, body.autorId, body.dataCatalogacao],</span><span class="dl ctx">       );</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       const livro = db</span><span class="dl ctx">         .query("SELECT * FROM livros WHERE id = ?")</span><span class="dl ctx">         .get(result.lastInsertRowid as number);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       return Response.json(livro, { status: 201 });</span><span class="dl ctx">     },</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx">   {</span><span class="dl ctx">     method: "GET",</span><span class="dl ctx">     pattern: "/livros/:q",</span><span class="dl ctx">     handler: (_request, params) =&gt; {</span><span class="dl del">-      const livros = db</span><span class="dl add">+      const q = params.q!;</span><span class="dl add">+</span><span class="dl add">+      const porIsbn = db</span><span class="dl ctx">         .query("SELECT * FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?")</span><span class="dl del">-        .all(params.q!);</span><span class="dl add">+        .all(q);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl del">-      return Response.json(livros);</span><span class="dl add">+      if (porIsbn.length &gt; 0) return Response.json(porIsbn);</span><span class="dl add">+</span><span class="dl add">+      const porTitulo = db</span><span class="dl add">+        .query("SELECT * FROM livros WHERE titulo LIKE ?")</span><span class="dl add">+        .all(`%${q}%`);</span><span class="dl add">+</span><span class="dl add">+      if (porTitulo.length &gt; 0) return Response.json(porTitulo);</span><span class="dl add">+</span><span class="dl add">+      const porAutor = db</span><span class="dl add">+        .query(</span><span class="dl add">+          `SELECT livros.* FROM livros</span><span class="dl add">+             JOIN autores ON autores.id = livros.autor_id</span><span class="dl add">+            WHERE autores.nome LIKE ?`,</span><span class="dl add">+        )</span><span class="dl add">+        .all(`%${q}%`);</span><span class="dl add">+</span><span class="dl add">+      return Response.json(porAutor);</span><span class="dl ctx">     },</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx"> ];</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> const server = Bun.serve({</span><span class="dl ctx">   port: 3000,</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   async fetch(request) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     const url = new URL(request.url);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">     for (const route of routes) {</span><span class="dl ctx">       if (route.method !== request.method) continue;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       const params = match(route.pattern, url.pathname);</span><span class="dl ctx">       if (params) return await route.handler(request, params);</span><span class="dl ctx">     }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">     return Response.json({ error: "Recurso não encontrado" }, { status: 404 });</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx"> });</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> console.log(`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`);</span></code></pre>

<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> http://localhost:3000/livros/9780132350884

<i class="t-com"># por trecho do título: o mesmo livro, achado por outro caminho</i>

<i class="t-com"># por nome do autor: exige o JOIN com autores</i>

<i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"id"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">2</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"numero_registro"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"R-2"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"isbn"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"9780132350884"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"titulo"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"Código Limpo"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"autor_id"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">2</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">200</i><i class="t-pun">]</i>
<i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"id"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">3</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"numero_registro"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"R-3"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"isbn"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"9780141439518"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"titulo"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"Orgulho e Preconceito"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"autor_id"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">4</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">200</i><i class="t-pun">]</i>
<i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">200</i><i class="t-pun">]</i></code></pre>

<p>As duas primeiras linhas são o mesmo livro, achado por dois caminhos diferentes. A última continua sendo <code>200</code>.</p></div>

<article class="fase" id="fase-12">
<header class="fase-head">
  <div class="fase-n">12</div>
  <div class="fase-t"><h2>RF04 — autor fora da base devolve 404</h2><div class="req">Requisitos: RF04</div></div>
</header>
<div class="fase-body">
  <div class="lead"><p>Você implementa o RF04: um livro só entra se o autor estiver na base, e a tentativa recusada devolve <code>404</code> com mensagem em português — não um <code>500</code> com stack trace. É a primeira regra de negócio do sistema, escrita como um <code>if</code> dentro do handler HTTP. Repare <strong>onde</strong> ela mora.</p></div>
  
  <div class="step"><h3>👨‍💻 O que você digita</h3><p>Antes do <code>INSERT</code>, uma consulta: existe autor com este <code>id</code>?</p>
<p><strong><code>src/index.ts</code></strong> — arquivo completo, com as mudanças marcadas</p>

<pre class="cb-body" id="c414-clean"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> db<i class="t-pun">,</i> createDb <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./db"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> patternParts <i class="t-pun">=</i> pattern<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">filter</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">Boolean</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> pathParts <i class="t-pun">=</i> path<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">filter</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">Boolean</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>patternParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> pathParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> params<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Record</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">let</i> i <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> <i class="t-fn">i</i> <i class="t-pun">&lt;</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length<i class="t-pun">;</i> i<i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> expected <i class="t-pun">=</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">[</i>i<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> received <i class="t-pun">=</i> pathParts<i class="t-pun">[</i>i<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>expected<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">startsWith</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">":"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      params<i class="t-pun">[</i>expected<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> received<i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">else</i> <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>expected <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> received<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>

    <i class="t-pun">}</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> message<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"API da Biblioteca"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"POST"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> body <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        dataCatalogacao<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> autor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db</strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM autores WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">!</i>autor<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Autor não cadastrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-pun">}</i></strong>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> result <i class="t-pun">=</i> db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
        <i class="t-str">`INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">[</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>titulo<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>dataCatalogacao<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
      <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livro <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>result<i class="t-pun">.</i>lastInsertRowid <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>livro<i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">201</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros/:q"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>_request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> q <i class="t-pun">=</i> params<i class="t-pun">.</i>q<i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porIsbn <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>q<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porTitulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE titulo LIKE ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">`SELECT livros.* FROM livros
             JOIN autores ON autores.id = livros.autor_id
            WHERE autores.nome LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porAutor<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> server <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">serve</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i>
  port<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">3000</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> url <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">URL</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">.</i>url<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> route <i class="t-kw">of</i> routes<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>method <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i>method<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> params <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">,</i> url<i class="t-pun">.</i>pathname<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> route<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">handler</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Recurso não encontrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>
<pre class="cb-body cb-diff" id="c414-diff" hidden><code><span class="dl ctx"> import { db, createDb } from "./db";</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> createDb();</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> type Handler = (</span><span class="dl ctx">   request: Request,</span><span class="dl ctx">   params: Record&lt;string, string&gt;,</span><span class="dl ctx"> ) =&gt; Response | Promise&lt;Response&gt;;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> type Route = { method: string; pattern: string; handler: Handler };</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> function match(pattern: string, path: string): Record&lt;string, string&gt; | null {</span><span class="dl ctx">   const patternParts = pattern.split("/").filter(Boolean);</span><span class="dl ctx">   const pathParts = path.split("/").filter(Boolean);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   if (patternParts.length !== pathParts.length) return null;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   const params: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {};</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   for (let i = 0; i &lt; patternParts.length; i++) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     const expected = patternParts[i]!;</span><span class="dl ctx">     const received = pathParts[i]!;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">     if (expected.startsWith(":")) {</span><span class="dl ctx">       params[expected.slice(1)] = received;</span><span class="dl ctx">     } else if (expected !== received) {</span><span class="dl ctx">       return null;</span><span class="dl ctx">     }</span><span class="dl ctx">   }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   return params;</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> const routes: Route[] = [</span><span class="dl ctx">   {</span><span class="dl ctx">     method: "GET",</span><span class="dl ctx">     pattern: "/",</span><span class="dl ctx">     handler: () =&gt; Response.json({ message: "API da Biblioteca" }),</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx">   {</span><span class="dl ctx">     method: "POST",</span><span class="dl ctx">     pattern: "/livros",</span><span class="dl ctx">     handler: async (request) =&gt; {</span><span class="dl ctx">       const body = (await request.json()) as {</span><span class="dl ctx">         isbn: string;</span><span class="dl ctx">         titulo: string;</span><span class="dl ctx">         autorId: number;</span><span class="dl ctx">         numeroRegistro: string;</span><span class="dl ctx">         dataCatalogacao: string;</span><span class="dl ctx">       };</span><span class="dl add">+</span><span class="dl add">+      const autor = db</span><span class="dl add">+        .query("SELECT * FROM autores WHERE id = ?")</span><span class="dl add">+        .get(body.autorId);</span><span class="dl add">+</span><span class="dl add">+      if (!autor) {</span><span class="dl add">+        return Response.json({ error: "Autor não cadastrado" }, { status: 404 });</span><span class="dl add">+      }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       const result = db.run(</span><span class="dl ctx">         `INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)</span><span class="dl ctx">          VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,</span><span class="dl ctx">         [body.numeroRegistro, body.isbn, body.titulo, body.autorId, body.dataCatalogacao],</span><span class="dl ctx">       );</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       const livro = db</span><span class="dl ctx">         .query("SELECT * FROM livros WHERE id = ?")</span><span class="dl ctx">         .get(result.lastInsertRowid as number);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       return Response.json(livro, { status: 201 });</span><span class="dl ctx">     },</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx">   {</span><span class="dl ctx">     method: "GET",</span><span class="dl ctx">     pattern: "/livros/:q",</span><span class="dl ctx">     handler: (_request, params) =&gt; {</span><span class="dl ctx">       const q = params.q!;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       const porIsbn = db</span><span class="dl ctx">         .query("SELECT * FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?")</span><span class="dl ctx">         .all(q);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       if (porIsbn.length &gt; 0) return Response.json(porIsbn);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       const porTitulo = db</span><span class="dl ctx">         .query("SELECT * FROM livros WHERE titulo LIKE ?")</span><span class="dl ctx">         .all(`%${q}%`);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       if (porTitulo.length &gt; 0) return Response.json(porTitulo);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       const porAutor = db</span><span class="dl ctx">         .query(</span><span class="dl ctx">           `SELECT livros.* FROM livros</span><span class="dl ctx">              JOIN autores ON autores.id = livros.autor_id</span><span class="dl ctx">             WHERE autores.nome LIKE ?`,</span><span class="dl ctx">         )</span><span class="dl ctx">         .all(`%${q}%`);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       return Response.json(porAutor);</span><span class="dl ctx">     },</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx"> ];</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> const server = Bun.serve({</span><span class="dl ctx">   port: 3000,</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">   async fetch(request) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     const url = new URL(request.url);</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">     for (const route of routes) {</span><span class="dl ctx">       if (route.method !== request.method) continue;</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">       const params = match(route.pattern, url.pathname);</span><span class="dl ctx">       if (params) return await route.handler(request, params);</span><span class="dl ctx">     }</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx">     return Response.json({ error: "Recurso não encontrado" }, { status: 404 });</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx"> });</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> console.log(`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`);</span></code></pre>
</div>

  <div class="fase-n">13</div>
  <div class="fase-t"><h2>RF05 — limite de 3 livros por autor</h2><div class="req">Requisitos: RF05</div></div>
</header>
<div class="fase-body">
  <div class="lead"><p>Você implementa o RF05: a biblioteca não guarda mais de três livros do mesmo autor, e a quarta tentativa devolve <code>409</code>. Mesma técnica e mesmo lugar da anterior — mais um <code>if</code> no mesmo handler. <strong>Guarde esta regra:</strong> ela é a que o documento inteiro vai perseguir.</p></div>

  <div class="step"><h3>👨‍💻 O que você digita</h3><p>Um <code>COUNT(*)</code> dos livros do autor e um <code>if</code>.</p>
<p><strong><code>src/index.ts</code></strong> — arquivo completo, com as mudanças marcadas</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="tgl" data-target="c415-diff" data-alt="c415-clean">ver o que mudou</button><button class="cp" data-code="c415-clean">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c415-clean"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> db<i class="t-pun">,</i> createDb <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./db"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-fn">createDb</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">type</i> <i class="t-typ">Handler</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>
  request<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Request</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  params<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Record</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">type</i> <i class="t-typ">Route</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Handler</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> path<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Record</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> patternParts <i class="t-pun">=</i> pattern<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">filter</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">Boolean</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> pathParts <i class="t-pun">=</i> path<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">filter</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">Boolean</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>patternParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> pathParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> params<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Record</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">let</i> i <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> <i class="t-fn">i</i> <i class="t-pun">&lt;</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length<i class="t-pun">;</i> i<i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> expected <i class="t-pun">=</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">[</i>i<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> received <i class="t-pun">=</i> pathParts<i class="t-pun">[</i>i<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>expected<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">startsWith</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">":"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      params<i class="t-pun">[</i>expected<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> received<i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">else</i> <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>expected <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> received<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> params<i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> routes<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Route</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> message<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"API da Biblioteca"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"POST"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> body <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        dataCatalogacao<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> autor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM autores WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">!</i>autor<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Autor não cadastrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-pun">}</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livrosDoAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db</strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros WHERE autor_id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>livrosDoAutor<i class="t-pun">.</i>total <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">3</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">          <i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"O autor já tem 3 livros no acervo"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> result <i class="t-pun">=</i> db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
        <i class="t-str">`INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">[</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>titulo<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>dataCatalogacao<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
      <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livro <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>result<i class="t-pun">.</i>lastInsertRowid <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>livro<i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">201</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros/:q"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>_request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> q <i class="t-pun">=</i> params<i class="t-pun">.</i>q<i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porIsbn <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>q<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porTitulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE titulo LIKE ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">`SELECT livros.* FROM livros
             JOIN autores ON autores.id = livros.autor_id
            WHERE autores.nome LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porAutor<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> server <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">serve</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i>
  port<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">3000</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> url <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">URL</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">.</i>url<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> route <i class="t-kw">of</i> routes<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>method <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i>method<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> params <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">,</i> url<i class="t-pun">.</i>pathname<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> route<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">handler</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Recurso não encontrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>

});</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx"> });</span><span class="dl ctx"> </span><span class="dl ctx"> console.log(`Servidor executando em   <div class="step test"><h3>✅ Como testar</h3><div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c67">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c67"><code><i class="t-cmd">rm</i> <i class="t-flag">-f</i> data/biblioteca.sqlite   # e reinicie o servidor

<i class="t-com"># cadastra quatro livros da mesma autora: os três primeiros passam, o quarto tem que bater no limite do RF05</i>
<i class="t-cmd">N</i>=0
<i class="t-cmd">while</i> IFS=<i class="t-str">'|'</i> read <i class="t-flag">-r</i> ISBN TITULO; do
  <i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST http://localhost:3000/livros \
    <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">"Content-Type: application/json"</i> \
    <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">"{\"isbn\":\"$ISBN\",\"titulo\":\"$TITULO\",\"autorId\":4,\"numeroRegistro\":\"R-$N\",\"dataCatalogacao\":\"2026-08-25\"}"</i>
  <i class="t-cmd">N</i>=$((N + 1))
<i class="t-cmd">done</i> &lt;&lt;<i class="t-str">'EOF'</i>
9780141439518<i class="t-pun">|</i>Orgulho e Preconceito
9780141439662<i class="t-pun">|</i>Razão e Sensibilidade
9780141439587<i class="t-pun">|</i>Emma
9780141439761<i class="t-pun">|</i>Persuasão
<i class="t-cmd">EOF</i></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cb cb-out">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">saída</span><div class="cb-actions"></div></div>

<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"id"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">2</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"numero_registro"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"R-1"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"isbn"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"9780141439662"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"titulo"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"Razão e Sensibilidade"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">201</i><i class="t-pun">]</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"id"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">3</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"numero_registro"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"R-2"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"isbn"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"9780141439587"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"titulo"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"Emma"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">201</i><i class="t-pun">]</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"error"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"O autor já tem 3 livros no acervo"</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">409</i><i class="t-pun">]</i></code></pre>
</div>
<p>O laço lê os quatro livros de um <em>heredoc</em>, e não de um array, de propósito: em <code>zsh</code> — o shell padrão do macOS — arrays começam em <strong>1</strong>, e um <code>${ISBNS[0]}</code> sairia vazio, cadastrando um livro sem ISBN nem título sem que nada reclamasse. O <code>while read</code> funciona igual em <code>bash</code> e em <code>zsh</code>.</p></div>
  <div class="step commit"><h3>📌 Commit da fase</h3><div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c69">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c69"><code><i class="t-cmd">git</i> add src/index.ts
<i class="t-cmd">git</i> commit <i class="t-flag">-m</i> <i class="t-str">"fase 13: RF05 limite de 3 livros por autor"</i></code></pre>
</div></div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="fase" id="fase-14">
<header class="fase-head">
  <div class="fase-n">14</div>
  <div class="fase-t"><h2>RF06 — a data de catalogação passa a ser calculada no servidor</h2><div class="req">Requisitos: RF06</div></div>
</header>
<div class="fase-body">
  <div class="lead"><p>Você implementa o RF06: a data de catalogação passa a ser a data de hoje, definida pelo servidor. Até agora quem a enviava era o cliente — ou seja, uma decisão do negócio estava fora do sistema, e nada impedia catalogar um livro em 1998.</p></div>
  
  <div class="step"><h3>👨‍💻 O que você digita</h3><p>O corpo da requisição encolhe: <code>dataCatalogacao</code> sai.</p>
<p><strong><code>src/index.ts</code></strong> — arquivo completo, com as mudanças marcadas</p>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> pathParts <i class="t-pun">=</i> path<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">filter</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">Boolean</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>patternParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> pathParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> params<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Record</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">let</i> i <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> <i class="t-fn">i</i> <i class="t-pun">&lt;</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length<i class="t-pun">;</i> i<i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> expected <i class="t-pun">=</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">[</i>i<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>expected<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">startsWith</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">":"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      params<i class="t-pun">[</i>expected<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> received<i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">else</i> <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>expected <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> received<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>

  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> params<i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> routes<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Route</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> message<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"API da Biblioteca"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"POST"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> body <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> autor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM autores WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">!</i>autor<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Autor não cadastrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livrosDoAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros WHERE autor_id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>livrosDoAutor<i class="t-pun">.</i>total <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">3</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"O autor já tem 3 livros no acervo"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> hoje <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">Date</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toISOString</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">10</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> result <i class="t-pun">=</i> db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
        <i class="t-str">`INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">[</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>titulo<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> hoje<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
      <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livro <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>result<i class="t-pun">.</i>lastInsertRowid <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>livro<i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">201</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros/:q"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>_request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> q <i class="t-pun">=</i> params<i class="t-pun">.</i>q<i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porIsbn <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>q<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porTitulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE titulo LIKE ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">`SELECT livros.* FROM livros
             JOIN autores ON autores.id = livros.autor_id
            WHERE autores.nome LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porAutor<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> server <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">serve</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i>
  port<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">3000</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> url <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">URL</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">.</i>url<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> route <i class="t-kw">of</i> routes<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>method <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i>method<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> params <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">,</i> url<i class="t-pun">.</i>pathname<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<article class="fase" id="fase-15">
<header class="fase-head">
  <div class="fase-n">15</div>
  <div class="fase-t"><h2>RF07 — o número de registro é gerado pelo servidor</h2><div class="req">Requisitos: RF07</div></div>
</header>
<div class="fase-body">
  <div class="lead"><p>Você implementa o RF07: o número de registro deixa de vir do cliente e passa a ser gerado pelo servidor no formato <code>AAAA-NNNNNN</code>, sequencial dentro do ano. O corpo da requisição encolhe até o osso: só <code>{ isbn, titulo, autorId }</code>.</p></div>
  
  <div class="step"><h3>👨‍💻 O que você digita</h3><p>O sequencial sai de um <code>COUNT(*)</code> dos livros catalogados no ano corrente.</p>
<p><strong><code>src/index.ts</code></strong> — arquivo completo, com as mudanças marcadas</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="tgl" data-target="c417-diff" data-alt="c417-clean">ver o que mudou</button><button class="cp" data-code="c417-clean">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c417-clean"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> db<i class="t-pun">,</i> createDb <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./db"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-fn">createDb</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
