  <i class="t-kw">const</i> pathParts <i class="t-pun">=</i> path<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">filter</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">Boolean</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>patternParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> pathParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">let</i> i <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> <i class="t-fn">i</i> <i class="t-pun">&lt;</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length<i class="t-pun">;</i> i<i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> expected <i class="t-pun">=</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">[</i>i<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> received <i class="t-pun">=</i> pathParts<i class="t-pun">[</i>i<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>expected<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">startsWith</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">":"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      params<i class="t-pun">[</i>expected<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> received<i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">else</i> <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>expected <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> received<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> routes<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Route</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>

  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"POST"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> body <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> autor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM autores WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">!</i>autor<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Autor não cadastrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> catalogadosNoAno <i class="t-pun">=</i> db</strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">          <i class="t-str">`SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros</i></strong><i class="t-str">
</i><strong class="ln-new"><i class="t-str">            WHERE data_catalogacao LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">)</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`${ano}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> numeroRegistro <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-str">`${ano}-${String(catalogadosNoAno.total + 1).padStart(6, "0")}`</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> result <i class="t-pun">=</i> db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
        <i class="t-str">`INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">[</i>numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>titulo<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> hoje<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
      <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livro <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>result<i class="t-pun">.</i>lastInsertRowid <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

  <i class="t-pun">{</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> q <i class="t-pun">=</i> params<i class="t-pun">.</i>q<i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porIsbn <i class="t-pun">=</i> db

        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>q<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porTitulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> db

        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

          <i class="t-str">`SELECT livros.* FROM livros

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porAutor<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> server <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">serve</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i>
  port<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">3000</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>

    <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> route <i class="t-kw">of</i> routes<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>method <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i>method<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> params <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">,</i> url<i class="t-pun">.</i>pathname<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> route<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">handler</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Recurso não encontrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>

  <div class="step test"><h3>✅ Como testar</h3><div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c75">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c75"><code><i class="t-cmd">rm</i> <i class="t-flag">-f</i> data/biblioteca.sqlite   # e reinicie o servidor

<i class="t-com"># três cadastros sem numeroRegistro: o servidor tem que gerar 2026-000001 a 000003 em sequência</i>
<i class="t-cmd">while</i> IFS=<i class="t-str">'|'</i> read <i class="t-flag">-r</i> ISBN TITULO; do
  <i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">"\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST http://localhost:3000/livros \
    <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">"Content-Type: application/json"</i> \
    <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">"{\"isbn\":\"$ISBN\",\"titulo\":\"$TITULO\",\"autorId\":4}"</i>
<i class="t-cmd">done</i> &lt;&lt;<i class="t-str">'EOF'</i>
9780141439518<i class="t-pun">|</i>Orgulho e Preconceito
9780141439662<i class="t-pun">|</i>Razão e Sensibilidade
9780141439587<i class="t-pun">|</i>Emma
<i class="t-cmd">EOF</i></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cb cb-out">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">resposta</span><div class="cb-actions"></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c76"><code><i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"id"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"numero_registro"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026-000001"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"isbn"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"9780141439518"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">}</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"id"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">2</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"numero_registro"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026-000002"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"isbn"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"9780141439662"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">}</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"id"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">3</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"numero_registro"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026-000003"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"isbn"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"9780141439587"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">}</i></code></pre>
</div>
<p>O corpo da requisição agora é <code>{"isbn","titulo","autorId"}</code> e nada mais: os três dados que só o cliente tem. Todo o resto — data e número de registro — é decisão do servidor.</p></div>

<header class="fase-head">
  <div class="fase-n">16</div>
  <div class="fase-t"><h2>RF08 — o mesmo ISBN não entra duas vezes</h2><div class="req">Requisitos: RF08</div></div>
</header>
<div class="fase-body">
  <div class="lead"><p>Você implementa o RF08: um ISBN identifica um livro, e a biblioteca não cataloga o mesmo livro duas vezes. Antes do <code>INSERT</code>, mais uma consulta — a terceira do handler. Regra simples de escrever, e é justamente por isso que ela serve: o que vale olhar aqui não é o <code>if</code>, é a <strong>janela</strong> que ele abre.</p></div>

<i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> path<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Record</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> pathParts <i class="t-pun">=</i> path<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">filter</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">Boolean</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">let</i> i <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> <i class="t-fn">i</i> <i class="t-pun">&lt;</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length<i class="t-pun">;</i> i<i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>

<i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-pun">{</i>

  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"POST"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> body <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>

<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> jaExiste <i class="t-pun">=</i> db</strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT 1 FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>jaExiste<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">          <i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Livro já cadastrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> hoje <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">Date</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toISOString</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">10</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> ano <i class="t-pun">=</i> hoje<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">4</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> catalogadosNoAno <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">`SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros
            WHERE data_catalogacao LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`${ano}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> numeroRegistro <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-str">`${ano}-${String(catalogadosNoAno.total + 1).padStart(6, "0")}`</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> result <i class="t-pun">=</i> db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
        <i class="t-str">`INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">[</i>numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>titulo<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> hoje<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
      <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livro <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>result<i class="t-pun">.</i>lastInsertRowid <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>livro<i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">201</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

  <i class="t-pun">{</i>

    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>_request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> q <i class="t-pun">=</i> params<i class="t-pun">.</i>q<i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porIsbn <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>q<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porTitulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE titulo LIKE ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db

          <i class="t-str">`SELECT livros.* FROM livros

            WHERE autores.nome LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porAutor<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> server <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">serve</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i>
  port<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">3000</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> url <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">URL</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">.</i>url<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> route <i class="t-kw">of</i> routes<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>method <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i>method<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> params <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">,</i> url<i class="t-pun">.</i>pathname<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> route<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">handler</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Recurso não encontrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>

<i class="t-com"># exatamente o mesmo comando de novo</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/livros \

<article class="fase" id="fase-17">
<header class="fase-head">
  <div class="fase-n">17</div>
  <div class="fase-t"><h2>RF09 — o mesmo autor, o mesmo título, duas vezes</h2><div class="req">Requisitos: RF09</div></div>
</header>
<div class="fase-body">
  <div class="lead"><p>Você implementa o RF09: duas edições da mesma obra têm ISBNs <strong>diferentes</strong> e continuam sendo a mesma obra. A biblioteca não quer o mesmo título do mesmo autor catalogado duas vezes. É a quarta regra dentro do mesmo handler — e já começa a incomodar.</p></div>

<pre class="cb-body" id="c419-clean"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> db<i class="t-pun">,</i> createDb <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./db"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-fn">createDb</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">type</i> <i class="t-typ">Handler</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>
  request<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Request</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  params<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Record</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">type</i> <i class="t-typ">Route</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Handler</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> path<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Record</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> patternParts <i class="t-pun">=</i> pattern<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">filter</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">Boolean</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> pathParts <i class="t-pun">=</i> path<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">filter</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">Boolean</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>patternParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> pathParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> params<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Record</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">let</i> i <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> <i class="t-fn">i</i> <i class="t-pun">&lt;</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length<i class="t-pun">;</i> i<i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> expected <i class="t-pun">=</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">[</i>i<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> received <i class="t-pun">=</i> pathParts<i class="t-pun">[</i>i<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>expected<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">startsWith</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">":"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      params<i class="t-pun">[</i>expected<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> received<i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">else</i> <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>expected <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> received<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> params<i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> routes<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Route</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> message<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"API da Biblioteca"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"POST"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> body <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> autor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM autores WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">!</i>autor<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Autor não cadastrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livrosDoAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros WHERE autor_id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>livrosDoAutor<i class="t-pun">.</i>total <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">3</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"O autor já tem 3 livros no acervo"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> jaExiste <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT 1 FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>jaExiste<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Livro já cadastrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> mesmoTitulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> db</strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">          <i class="t-str">"SELECT 1 FROM livros WHERE autor_id = ? AND lower(titulo) = lower(?)"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">)</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>titulo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>mesmoTitulo<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">          <i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Este autor já tem um livro com este título"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-pun">}</i></strong>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> hoje <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">Date</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toISOString</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">10</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> ano <i class="t-pun">=</i> hoje<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">4</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> catalogadosNoAno <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">`SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros
            WHERE data_catalogacao LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`${ano}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> numeroRegistro <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-str">`${ano}-${String(catalogadosNoAno.total + 1).padStart(6, "0")}`</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> result <i class="t-pun">=</i> db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
        <i class="t-str">`INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">[</i>numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>titulo<i class="t-pun">,</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> hoje<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
      <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livro <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>result<i class="t-pun">.</i>lastInsertRowid <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>livro<i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">201</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros/:q"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>_request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> q <i class="t-pun">=</i> params<i class="t-pun">.</i>q<i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porIsbn <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>q<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porTitulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE titulo LIKE ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">`SELECT livros.* FROM livros
             JOIN autores ON autores.id = livros.autor_id
            WHERE autores.nome LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porAutor<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> server <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">serve</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i>
  port<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">3000</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> url <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">URL</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">.</i>url<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> route <i class="t-kw">of</i> routes<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>method <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i>method<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> params <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">,</i> url<i class="t-pun">.</i>pathname<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> route<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">handler</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Recurso não encontrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>

<pre class="cb-body" id="c83"><code><i class="t-cmd">rm</i> <i class="t-flag">-f</i> data/biblioteca.sqlite   # e reinicie o servidor

<i class="t-com"># primeira edição</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/livros \
  <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">'Content-Type: application/json'</i> \
  <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">'{"isbn":"9780141439518","titulo":"Orgulho e Preconceito","autorId":4}'</i>

<i class="t-com"># outra edição da MESMA obra: ISBN diferente, título igual</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/livros \
  <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">'Content-Type: application/json'</i> \
  <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">'{"isbn":"9780141439563","titulo":"orgulho e preconceito","autorId":4}'</i></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cb cb-out">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">saída</span><div class="cb-actions"></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c84"><code><i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"id"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">201</i><i class="t-pun">]</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"error"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"Este autor já tem um livro com este título"</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">409</i><i class="t-pun">]</i></code></pre>
</div>
<p>Repare no <code>lower()</code> das duas pontas: <code>orgulho e preconceito</code> foi recusado. Isso é uma decisão de negócio disfarçada de detalhe de SQL — e ela vai reaparecer na fase 43, quando o dublê em memória tiver que decidir se compara do mesmo jeito.</p></div>
  <div class="step commit"><h3>📌 Commit da fase</h3><div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c85">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c85"><code><i class="t-cmd">git</i> add src/index.ts
<i class="t-cmd">git</i> commit <i class="t-flag">-m</i> <i class="t-str">"fase 17: RF09 mesmo autor nao repete titulo"</i></code></pre>
</div></div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="fase" id="fase-18">
<header class="fase-head">
  <div class="fase-n">18</div>
  <div class="fase-t"><h2>RF10 — o ISBN é normalizado antes de gravar e de comparar</h2><div class="req">Requisitos: RF10</div></div>
</header>
<div class="fase-body">
  <div class="lead"><p>Você implementa o RF10: o ISBN chega do mundo real com hífens e espaços (<code>978-0-321-12521-7</code>) e precisa virar só dígitos antes de qualquer comparação. Sem isso, o mesmo livro entra duas vezes ou some da busca, dependendo de como o operador digitou.</p></div>
  
  <div class="step"><h3>👨‍💻 O que você digita</h3><p>Três linhas no começo do handler, e todo o resto passa a usar <code>isbn</code> em vez de <code>body.isbn</code>. Só o ISBN é de fato normalizado — <code>titulo</code> e <code>autorId</code> ganham um nome curto e nada mais, para que daqui em diante o handler leia o mesmo em todos os pontos. Repare que a normalização acontece <strong>antes</strong> da primeira consulta, e não na hora de gravar: é isso que faz o RF08 e o RF09 compararem maçãs com maçãs.</p>
<p><strong><code>src/index.ts</code></strong> — arquivo completo, com as mudanças marcadas</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="tgl" data-target="c420-diff" data-alt="c420-clean">ver o que mudou</button><button class="cp" data-code="c420-clean">copiar</button></div></div>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> pathParts <i class="t-pun">=</i> path<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">filter</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">Boolean</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>patternParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> pathParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> params<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Record</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">let</i> i <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> <i class="t-fn">i</i> <i class="t-pun">&lt;</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length<i class="t-pun">;</i> i<i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> expected <i class="t-pun">=</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">[</i>i<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> received <i class="t-pun">=</i> pathParts<i class="t-pun">[</i>i<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>expected<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">startsWith</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">":"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      params<i class="t-pun">[</i>expected<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> received<i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">else</i> <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>expected <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> received<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> params<i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> routes<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Route</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>

    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> message<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"API da Biblioteca"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"POST"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> body <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> isbn <i class="t-pun">=</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">replace</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">/</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">^</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">-</i><i class="t-num">9</i><i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">/</i>g<i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">""</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> titulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>titulo<i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> autorId <i class="t-pun">=</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> autor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM autores WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">!</i>autor<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Autor não cadastrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livrosDoAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros WHERE autor_id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>livrosDoAutor<i class="t-pun">.</i>total <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">3</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"O autor já tem 3 livros no acervo"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> jaExiste <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT 1 FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>jaExiste<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Livro já cadastrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> mesmoTitulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">"SELECT 1 FROM livros WHERE autor_id = ? AND lower(titulo) = lower(?)"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>mesmoTitulo<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Este autor já tem um livro com este título"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> hoje <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">Date</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toISOString</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">10</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> ano <i class="t-pun">=</i> hoje<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">4</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> catalogadosNoAno <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">`SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros
            WHERE data_catalogacao LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`${ano}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> numeroRegistro <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-str">`${ano}-${String(catalogadosNoAno.total + 1).padStart(6, "0")}`</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> result <i class="t-pun">=</i> db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
        <i class="t-str">`INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">[</i>numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">,</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">,</i> autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> hoje<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
      <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livro <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>result<i class="t-pun">.</i>lastInsertRowid <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>livro<i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">201</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros/:q"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>_request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> q <i class="t-pun">=</i> params<i class="t-pun">.</i>q<i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porIsbn <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>q<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porTitulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE titulo LIKE ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">`SELECT livros.* FROM livros
             JOIN autores ON autores.id = livros.autor_id
            WHERE autores.nome LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porAutor<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> server <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">serve</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i>
  port<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">3000</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>

    <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> route <i class="t-kw">of</i> routes<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>method <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i>method<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> params <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">,</i> url<i class="t-pun">.</i>pathname<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> route<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">handler</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Recurso não encontrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>

<p>A consulta do RF08 é a que mais importa aqui: é ela que precisa comparar o ISBN já reduzido a dígitos, senão <code>978-0-321-12521-7</code> passa direto por cima de <code>9780321125217</code>.</p>

  <div class="step test"><h3>✅ Como testar</h3><p>Continuando de onde a fase 17 parou — um livro no acervo, <em>Orgulho e Preconceito</em>. Agora o mesmo ISBN, escrito de duas formas diferentes:</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c91">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c91"><code><i class="t-com"># como o operador digitou, com hífens</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/livros \
  <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">'Content-Type: application/json'</i> <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">'{"isbn":"978-0-321-12521-7","titulo":"Domain-Driven Design","autorId":1}'</i>

<i class="t-com"># o mesmo ISBN, agora só com dígitos</i>
<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-w</i> <i class="t-str">" [%{http_code}]\n"</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/livros \
  <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">'Content-Type: application/json'</i> <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">'{"isbn":"9780321125217","titulo":"Domain-Driven Design","autorId":1}'</i></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cb cb-out">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">saída</span><div class="cb-actions"></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c92"><code><i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"id"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-num">2</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"numero_registro"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"2026-000002"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-key">"isbn"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"9780321125217"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">201</i><i class="t-pun">]</i>
<i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-key">"error"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i><i class="t-str">"Livro já cadastrado"</i><i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">409</i><i class="t-pun">]</i></code></pre>
</div>
<p>Duas coisas na primeira linha: o ISBN foi <strong>gravado</strong> sem os hífens, e não como chegou. E é por isso que a segunda linha funciona — o RF08 recusa a segunda tentativa mesmo ela estando escrita de outro jeito, porque as duas viraram a mesma string antes da comparação.</p>
<p>Antes desta fase o par acima devolvia <code>201</code> duas vezes: o acervo ficava com o mesmo livro catalogado duas vezes, uma cópia com hífens e outra sem, e a busca por <code>9780321125217</code> só achava uma delas.</p></div>
  <div class="step commit"><h3>📌 Commit da fase</h3><div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">terminal</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c93">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c93"><code><i class="t-cmd">git</i> add src/index.ts
<i class="t-cmd">git</i> commit <i class="t-flag">-m</i> <i class="t-str">"fase 18: RF10 normalizacao do ISBN"</i></code></pre>
</div></div>
</div>
</article>

  <div class="fase-n">19</div>
  <div class="fase-t"><h2>RF11 — o contrato de resposta</h2><div class="req">Requisitos: RF11</div></div>
</header>
<div class="fase-body">
  <div class="lead"><p>Você implementa o RF11: a resposta de sucesso passa a ser <code>201</code> com o cabeçalho <code>Location</code> apontando para a busca do livro recém-catalogado, e o corpo passa a incluir o nome do autor. Fim do bloco ingênuo: a especificação inteira está implementada e funcionando.</p></div>

<i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> path<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Record</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> patternParts <i class="t-pun">=</i> pattern<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">filter</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">Boolean</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> pathParts <i class="t-pun">=</i> path<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"/"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">filter</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">Boolean</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">let</i> i <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> <i class="t-fn">i</i> <i class="t-pun">&lt;</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">.</i>length<i class="t-pun">;</i> i<i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> expected <i class="t-pun">=</i> patternParts<i class="t-pun">[</i>i<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>expected<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">startsWith</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">":"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>

    <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">else</i> <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>expected <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> received<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> params<i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> routes<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Route</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"POST"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> body <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> isbn <i class="t-pun">=</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">replace</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">/</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">^</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">-</i><i class="t-num">9</i><i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">/</i>g<i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">""</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> titulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>titulo<i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> autorId <i class="t-pun">=</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> autor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM autores WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> id<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> nome<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> orcid<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">!</i>autor<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Autor não cadastrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livrosDoAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros WHERE autor_id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>livrosDoAutor<i class="t-pun">.</i>total <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">3</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"O autor já tem 3 livros no acervo"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> jaExiste <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT 1 FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
