          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> mesmoTitulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">"SELECT 1 FROM livros WHERE autor_id = ? AND lower(titulo) = lower(?)"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>mesmoTitulo<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Este autor já tem um livro com este título"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> hoje <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">Date</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toISOString</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">10</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> ano <i class="t-pun">=</i> hoje<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">4</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> catalogadosNoAno <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">`SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros
            WHERE data_catalogacao LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`${ano}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> numeroRegistro <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-str">`${ano}-${String(catalogadosNoAno.total + 1).padStart(6, "0")}`</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> result <i class="t-pun">=</i> db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
        <i class="t-str">`INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">[</i>numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">,</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">,</i> autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> hoje<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
      <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livro <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>result<i class="t-pun">.</i>lastInsertRowid <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">Record</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">unknown</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i>livro<i class="t-pun">,</i> autor<i class="t-pun">:</i> autor<i class="t-pun">.</i>nome <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">{</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">          status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">201</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">          headers<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">Location</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">`/livros/${isbn}`</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros/:q"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>_request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> q <i class="t-pun">=</i> params<i class="t-pun">.</i>q<i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porIsbn <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>q<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porTitulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE titulo LIKE ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">`SELECT livros.* FROM livros
             JOIN autores ON autores.id = livros.autor_id
            WHERE autores.nome LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porAutor<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> server <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">serve</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i>
  port<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">3000</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> url <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">URL</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">.</i>url<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> route <i class="t-kw">of</i> routes<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>method <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i>method<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> params <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">,</i> url<i class="t-pun">.</i>pathname<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> route<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">handler</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Recurso não encontrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>

<i class="t-cmd">curl</i> <i class="t-flag">-i</i> <i class="t-flag">-X</i> POST localhost:3000/livros \
  <i class="t-flag">-H</i> <i class="t-str">'Content-Type: application/json'</i> <i class="t-flag">-d</i> <i class="t-str">'{"isbn":"9780321125217","titulo":"Domain-Driven Design","autorId":1}'</i></code></pre>

<article class="fase mk" id="fase-20">
<header class="fase-head">
  <div class="fase-n">20</div>
  <div class="fase-t"><h2>⏱ TEMPO 1 — o primeiro teste automatizado da regra</h2></div>
</header>
<div class="fase-body">
  <div class="lead"><p>Você escreve o primeiro teste automatizado da regra do limite (RF05). Ele vai passar. O que interessa não é o resultado — é <strong>medir o custo</strong>: quantas linhas, quanto tempo e quanta infraestrutura precisa subir para exercitar quatro linhas de regra de negócio.</p></div>
  
  <div class="step"><h3>👨‍💻 O que você digita</h3><p>O Bun traz o runner de testes embutido (<code>bun:test</code>), então de novo nenhuma dependência nova.</p>
<p>Para exercitar a regra do limite, o teste precisa:</p>
<ol><li>subir a aplicação inteira como um processo separado;</li><li>esperar a porta abrir;</li><li>abrir uma segunda conexão com o banco só para limpá-lo entre os testes;</li><li>cadastrar quatro livros <strong>via HTTP</strong>, porque não há outro caminho.</li></ol>
<p>E há um detalhe que só aparece quando você deixa o servidor rodando em outro terminal: o teste sobe <strong>o seu próprio</strong> servidor, e os dois não cabem na mesma porta. Pior — a sonda do passo 2 pergunta apenas se <em>alguém</em> atende em <code>localhost:3000</code>, e o servidor que já estava lá responde por ele. O teste passaria conversando com o processo errado.</p>
<p>Duas linhas fecham isso. A porta do servidor passa a vir do ambiente, e o teste dá a si mesmo uma porta só sua:</p>

<p><strong><code>src/index.ts</code></strong> — só a linha da porta</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c423b">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c423b"><code>  port<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-fn">Number</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>process<i class="t-pun">.</i>env<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-typ">PORT</i> <i class="t-pun">??</i> <i class="t-num">3000</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></code></pre>
</div>
<p>Sem <code>PORT</code> no ambiente nada muda: <code>bun run dev</code> continua na 3000. Quem passa a mandar é quem define a variável — e quem define é o teste.</p>

<p>E, como agora dois processos escrevem no mesmo arquivo SQLite, vale ensinar o banco a esperar. O padrão do Bun é <code>busy_timeout</code> zero: qualquer disputa vira <code>SQLITE_BUSY</code> na hora, em vez de uma pausa de milissegundos.</p>

<p><strong><code>src/db.ts</code></strong> — logo abaixo do PRAGMA que já existe</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c423c">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c423c"><code><i class="t-com">// dois processos podem abrir este arquivo ao mesmo tempo — o servidor e o</i>
<i class="t-com">// teste. Sem isto o segundo leva SQLITE_BUSY na hora, em vez de esperar.</i>
db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>
</div>

<p>Acrescente também o script <code>"test": "bun test"</code> no <code>package.json</code>.</p>

<p><strong><code>package.json</code></strong> — arquivo completo, com as mudanças marcadas</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="tgl" data-target="c422-diff" data-alt="c422-clean">ver o que mudou</button><button class="cp" data-code="c422-clean">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c422-clean"><code><i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-key">"name"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"biblioteca"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-key">"module"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"src/index.ts"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-key">"type"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"module"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-key">"private"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">true</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-key">"scripts"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-key">"dev"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"bun --watch src/index.ts"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<strong class="ln-new">    <i class="t-key">"start"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"bun src/index.ts"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">    <i class="t-key">"test"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"bun test"</i></strong>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-key">"devDependencies"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-key">"@types/bun"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"latest"</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-key">"peerDependencies"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-key">"typescript"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"^7"</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i></code></pre>
<pre class="cb-body cb-diff" id="c422-diff" hidden><code><span class="dl ctx"> {</span><span class="dl ctx">   "name": "biblioteca",</span><span class="dl ctx">   "module": "src/index.ts",</span><span class="dl ctx">   "type": "module",</span><span class="dl ctx">   "private": true,</span><span class="dl ctx">   "scripts": {</span><span class="dl ctx">     "dev": "bun --watch src/index.ts",</span><span class="dl del">-    "start": "bun src/index.ts"</span><span class="dl add">+    "start": "bun src/index.ts",</span><span class="dl add">+    "test": "bun test"</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx">   "devDependencies": {</span><span class="dl ctx">     "@types/bun": "latest"</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx">   "peerDependencies": {</span><span class="dl ctx">     "typescript": "^7"</span><span class="dl ctx">   }</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span></code></pre>
</div>

<p><strong><code>tests/cadastro.e2e.test.ts</code></strong> — arquivo novo</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c423">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c423"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> afterAll<i class="t-pun">,</i> beforeAll<i class="t-pun">,</i> beforeEach<i class="t-pun">,</i> expect<i class="t-pun">,</i> test <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"bun:test"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> db <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"../src/db"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-typ">BASE</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-str">"http://localhost:3999"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-typ">AUSTEN</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">4</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-typ">LIVROS</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439518"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Orgulho e Preconceito"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439662"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Razão e Sensibilidade"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439587"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Emma"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439761"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Persuasão"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439563"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"A Abadia de Northanger"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141199689"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Lady Susan"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">let</i> server<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">ReturnType</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-kw">typeof</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i>spawn<i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-fn">beforeAll</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-com">// não há como exercitar a regra sem subir a aplicação inteira</i>
  server <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">spawn</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-str">"bun"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"src/index.ts"</i><i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    stdout<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"ignore"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    <i class="t-com">// porta própria: a sonda abaixo só passa quando ESTE servidor subir</i>
    env<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-pun">...</i>process<i class="t-pun">.</i>env<i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">PORT</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"3999"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-com">// ... e sem esperar a porta abrir</i>
  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">let</i> tentativa <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> <i class="t-fn">tentativa</i> <i class="t-pun">&lt;</i> <i class="t-num">50</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> tentativa<i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">try</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">BASE</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">return</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">catch</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">sleep</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">100</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">throw</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">Error</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"o servidor não subiu"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-fn">afterAll</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  server<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">kill</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-fn">beforeEach</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-com">// ... e sem limpar o banco de verdade entre um teste e outro</i>
  db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"DELETE FROM livros"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">cadastrar</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>n<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> autorId <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">AUSTEN</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`${BASE}/livros`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"POST"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    headers<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-str">"Content-Type"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"application/json"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    body<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">JSON</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">stringify</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-typ">LIVROS</i><i class="t-pun">[</i>n<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> autorId <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-fn">test</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"RF05: o autor não pode ter mais de 3 livros no acervo"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">let</i> i <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> <i class="t-fn">i</i> <i class="t-pun">&lt;</i> <i class="t-num">3</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> i<i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> response <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-fn">cadastrar</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>i<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-fn">expect</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>response<i class="t-pun">.</i>status<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toBe</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">201</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> quarto <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-fn">cadastrar</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">3</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-fn">expect</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>quarto<i class="t-pun">.</i>status<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toBe</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">409</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>
</div></div>

<article class="fase mk" id="fase-21">
<header class="fase-head">
  <div class="fase-n">21</div>
  <div class="fase-t"><h2>💣 GOLPE 1 — RF12: importação de acervo via linha de comando</h2><div class="req">Requisitos: RF12</div></div>
</header>
<div class="fase-body">
  <div class="lead"><p>💣 Entra o RF12, um requisito novo e perfeitamente razoável: a biblioteca recebeu uma doação de trezentos volumes e a listagem veio em CSV. Ela quer importar por linha de comando. As <strong>mesmas regras</strong> de negócio valem — e é aí que mora o problema.</p></div>

  <text x="40" y="42" class="t" font-size="18" font-weight="600">Fase 21 — GOLPE 1 — a segunda porta de entrada</text>
  <text x="40" y="64" class="s" font-size="13">A importação por CSV não usa HTTP. E a regra do limite, que vivia no handler, precisou ser copiada.</text>

  <text x="480" y="394" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="700">A duplicação não apareceu porque o sistema é grande.</text>
  <text x="480" y="414" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="700">Apareceu porque o sistema ganhou uma segunda porta de entrada.</text>
  <text x="480" y="442" font-size="11.5" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6b7280" font-weight="400">Três blocos idênticos em dois arquivos, num sistema de dois casos de uso — e um deles não tem regra nenhuma</text>
  <text x="480" y="459" font-size="11.5" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6b7280" font-weight="400">para duplicar. Um sistema com uma feature e duas portas tem o mesmo problema que um com quatorze features</text>
  <text x="480" y="476" font-size="11.5" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6b7280" font-weight="400">e duas portas. Qual é a chance de as duas cópias continuarem iguais daqui a seis meses?</text>
</svg></div><figcaption>Arquitetura da fase 21</figcaption></figure>
  <div class="step"><h3>👨‍💻 O que você digita</h3><p>Você precisa das regras RF04, RF05, RF06, RF07 e RF10 dentro de um programa de linha de comando. Só que elas não são funções: são <code>if</code>s e expressões dentro de um handler HTTP.</p>
<p>Não existe caminho honesto aqui. <strong>Copie e cole</strong> o bloco de regras de <code>src/index.ts</code> para <code>src/importar.ts</code>. É o que qualquer pessoa faria com este desenho, e é o que você vai fazer.</p>
<p>Acrescente o script <code>"importar": "bun src/importar.ts"</code> ao <code>package.json</code>.</p>

<p><strong><code>package.json</code></strong> — arquivo completo, com as mudanças marcadas</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="tgl" data-target="c424-diff" data-alt="c424-clean">ver o que mudou</button><button class="cp" data-code="c424-clean">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c424-clean"><code><i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-key">"name"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"biblioteca"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-key">"module"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"src/index.ts"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-key">"type"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"module"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-key">"private"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">true</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-key">"scripts"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-key">"dev"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"bun --watch src/index.ts"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    <i class="t-key">"start"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"bun src/index.ts"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<strong class="ln-new">    <i class="t-key">"test"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"bun test"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">    <i class="t-key">"importar"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"bun src/importar.ts"</i></strong>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-key">"devDependencies"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-key">"@types/bun"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"latest"</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-key">"peerDependencies"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-key">"typescript"</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"^7"</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i></code></pre>
<pre class="cb-body cb-diff" id="c424-diff" hidden><code><span class="dl ctx"> {</span><span class="dl ctx">   "name": "biblioteca",</span><span class="dl ctx">   "module": "src/index.ts",</span><span class="dl ctx">   "type": "module",</span><span class="dl ctx">   "private": true,</span><span class="dl ctx">   "scripts": {</span><span class="dl ctx">     "dev": "bun --watch src/index.ts",</span><span class="dl ctx">     "start": "bun src/index.ts",</span><span class="dl del">-    "test": "bun test"</span><span class="dl add">+    "test": "bun test",</span><span class="dl add">+    "importar": "bun src/importar.ts"</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx">   "devDependencies": {</span><span class="dl ctx">     "@types/bun": "latest"</span><span class="dl ctx">   },</span><span class="dl ctx">   "peerDependencies": {</span><span class="dl ctx">     "typescript": "^7"</span><span class="dl ctx">   }</span><span class="dl ctx"> }</span></code></pre>

<p><strong><code>src/importar.ts</code></strong> — arquivo novo</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c425">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c425"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> db<i class="t-pun">,</i> createDb <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"./db"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-fn">createDb</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> path <i class="t-pun">=</i> process<i class="t-pun">.</i>argv<i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">2</i><i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">!</i>path<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">error</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"uso: bun run importar &lt;arquivo.csv&gt;"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  process<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">exit</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> content <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">file</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>path<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">text</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">const</i> rows <i class="t-pun">=</i> content<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">trim</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"\n"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">1</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">let</i> importados <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">let</i> rejeitados <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> row <i class="t-kw">of</i> rows<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-com">// ⚠️ daqui para baixo é cópia do que existe em src/index.ts — mas só de</i>
  <i class="t-com">// PARTE do que existe lá: o RF08 e o RF09 ficaram de fora. Repare nisso.</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>isbnBruto<i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">,</i> autorBruto<i class="t-pun">]</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> row<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">split</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">","</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>
    <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> isbn <i class="t-pun">=</i> isbnBruto<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">replace</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">/</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">^</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">-</i><i class="t-num">9</i><i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">/</i>g<i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">""</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> autorId <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Number</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorBruto<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> autor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM autores WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">!</i>autor<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`linha rejeitada (autor não cadastrado): ${row}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    rejeitados<i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> livrosDoAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
    <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
      <i class="t-str">`SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros
        WHERE autor_id = ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    <i class="t-pun">)</i>
    <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>livrosDoAutor<i class="t-pun">.</i>total <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">3</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`linha rejeitada (limite atingido): ${row}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    rejeitados<i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> hoje <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">Date</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toISOString</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">10</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> ano <i class="t-pun">=</i> hoje<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">4</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> catalogadosNoAno <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
    <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
      <i class="t-str">`SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros
        WHERE data_catalogacao LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    <i class="t-pun">)</i>
    <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`${ano}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> numeroRegistro <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-str">`${ano}-${String(catalogadosNoAno.total + 1).padStart(6, "0")}`</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
    <i class="t-str">`INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    <i class="t-pun">[</i>numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">,</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">,</i> autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> hoje<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  importados<i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">+</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`importados: ${importados} | rejeitados: ${rejeitados}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>
</div>

<p><strong><code>tests/importacao.test.ts</code></strong> — arquivo novo</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c426">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c426"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> beforeEach<i class="t-pun">,</i> expect<i class="t-pun">,</i> test <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"bun:test"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> db<i class="t-pun">,</i> createDb <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"../src/db"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-typ">AUSTEN</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-num">4</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-kw">const</i> <i class="t-typ">LIVROS</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">[</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439518"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Orgulho e Preconceito"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439662"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Razão e Sensibilidade"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439587"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Emma"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439761"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Persuasão"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141439563"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"A Abadia de Northanger"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"9780141199689"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Lady Susan"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-fn">createDb</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-fn">beforeEach</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"DELETE FROM livros"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">importar</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>csv<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">Promise</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-kw">void</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">write</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"data/importacao-teste.csv"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> csv<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">const</i> processo <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">spawn</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
    <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-str">"bun"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"src/importar.ts"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"data/importacao-teste.csv"</i><i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    <i class="t-pun">{</i> stdout<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"ignore"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">await</i> processo<i class="t-pun">.</i>exited<i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">noAcervo</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> row <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
    <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
      <i class="t-str">`SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros
        WHERE autor_id = ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    <i class="t-pun">)</i>
    <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">return</i> row<i class="t-pun">.</i>total<i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">linhasCsv</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>livros<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">typeof</i> <i class="t-typ">LIVROS</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>
    <i class="t-str">"isbn,titulo,autorId\n"</i> <i class="t-pun">+</i>
    livros<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">map</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>l<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-str">`${l.isbn},${l.titulo},${autorId}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">join</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"\n"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">+</i>
    <i class="t-str">"\n"</i>
  <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-fn">test</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"RF05 também vale para a importação em lote"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  <i class="t-kw">const</i> csv <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">linhasCsv</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">LIVROS</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">6</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">AUSTEN</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-kw">await</i> <i class="t-fn">importar</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>csv<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

  <i class="t-fn">expect</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-fn">noAcervo</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-typ">AUSTEN</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toBe</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">3</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>
</div></div>

  <div class="fase-n">22</div>
  <div class="fase-t"><h2>💣 GOLPE 2 — o limite muda, e só metade do sistema fica sabendo</h2><div class="req">Requisitos: RF05′</div></div>

  <div class="lead"><p>💣 O RF05 muda: o limite passa de três para <strong>cinco</strong>, e autores <strong>didáticos</strong> podem ter <strong>dez</strong>. Requisito trivial.   <div class="step"><h3>👨‍💻 O que você digita</h3><p>São quatro mudanças:</p>
<ol><li><strong>schema</strong>: <code>autores</code> ganha a coluna <code>tipo</code> (<code>'literatura'</code> por padrão);</li><li>o seed passa a informar o tipo de cada autor;</li><li><code>POST /livros</code> calcula o limite a partir do tipo do autor;</li><li>os testes são atualizados para a regra nova.</li></ol>
<p>Repare que o item 1 <strong>não é uma migração</strong>: <code>CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS</code> não altera tabela que já existe, e a coluna só aparece porque a verificação apaga o banco antes de rodar. Num banco de verdade, com dados, a coluna nunca surgiria e o limite cairia para cinco em silêncio — sem erro nenhum. Este documento recria o banco o tempo todo e por isso escapa; sistemas em produção não escapam, e é daí que vem a disciplina de migração versionada.</p>
<p>Faça exatamente isso — e <strong>não olhe para <code>src/importar.ts</code></strong>. Você não tem motivo para olhar: você foi ao lugar onde a regra estava, e mudou.</p>

<strong class="ln-new">  <i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-num">4</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"Jane Austen"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">"literatura"</i><i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">    insert<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>id<i class="t-pun">,</i> nome<i class="t-pun">,</i> tipo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i>

<i class="t-kw">export</i> <i class="t-kw">function</i> <i class="t-fn">createDb</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
  db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`

    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> message<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"API da Biblioteca"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"POST"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> body <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">await</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        isbn<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        titulo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
        autorId<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> isbn <i class="t-pun">=</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">replace</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">/</i><i class="t-pun">[</i><i class="t-pun">^</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">-</i><i class="t-num">9</i><i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">/</i>g<i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-str">""</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> titulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>titulo<i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> autorId <i class="t-pun">=</i> body<i class="t-pun">.</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> autor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM autores WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> id<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> nome<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> orcid<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i> <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i> tipo<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">string</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">        <i class="t-pun">|</i> <i class="t-kw">null</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">!</i>autor<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Autor não cadastrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livrosDoAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros WHERE autor_id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> noAcervo <i class="t-pun">=</i> livrosDoAutor<i class="t-pun">.</i>total<i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>
<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">const</i> limite <i class="t-pun">=</i> autor<i class="t-pun">.</i>tipo <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-str">"didatico"</i> <i class="t-pun">?</i> <i class="t-num">10</i> <i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">5</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></strong>

<strong class="ln-new">      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>noAcervo <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> limite<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i></strong>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
<strong class="ln-new">          <i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">`O autor já tem ${limite} livros no acervo`</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i></strong>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> jaExiste <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT 1 FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>isbn<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>jaExiste<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Livro já cadastrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> mesmoTitulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">"SELECT 1 FROM livros WHERE autor_id = ? AND lower(titulo) = lower(?)"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>mesmoTitulo<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
        <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Este autor já tem um livro com este título"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
          <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">409</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-pun">}</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> hoje <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">Date</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">toISOString</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">10</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> ano <i class="t-pun">=</i> hoje<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">slice</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-num">4</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> catalogadosNoAno <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">`SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM livros
            WHERE data_catalogacao LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`${ano}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> total<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> numeroRegistro <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-str">`${ano}-${String(catalogadosNoAno.total + 1).padStart(6, "0")}`</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> result <i class="t-pun">=</i> db<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">run</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
        <i class="t-str">`INSERT INTO livros (numero_registro, isbn, titulo, autor_id, data_catalogacao)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">[</i>numeroRegistro<i class="t-pun">,</i> isbn<i class="t-pun">,</i> titulo<i class="t-pun">,</i> autorId<i class="t-pun">,</i> hoje<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
      <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> livro <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE id = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-kw">get</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>result<i class="t-pun">.</i>lastInsertRowid <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">number</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">as</i> <i class="t-typ">Record</i><i class="t-pun">&lt;</i><i class="t-typ">string</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-typ">unknown</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
        <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-pun">.</i>livro<i class="t-pun">,</i> autor<i class="t-pun">:</i> autor<i class="t-pun">.</i>nome <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">{</i>
          status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">201</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
          headers<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> <i class="t-typ">Location</i><i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">`/livros/${isbn}`</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
      <i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    method<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"GET"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    pattern<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"/livros/:q"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
    handler<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>_request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">const</i> q <i class="t-pun">=</i> params<i class="t-pun">.</i>q<i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porIsbn <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE isbn = ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>q<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porIsbn<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porTitulo <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"SELECT * FROM livros WHERE titulo LIKE ?"</i><i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">.</i>length <i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-num">0</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porTitulo<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> porAutor <i class="t-pun">=</i> db
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">query</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>
          <i class="t-str">`SELECT livros.* FROM livros
             JOIN autores ON autores.id = livros.autor_id
            WHERE autores.nome LIKE ?`</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
        <i class="t-pun">)</i>
        <i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">all</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`%${q}%`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>porAutor<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">]</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-kw">const</i> server <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-typ">Bun</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">serve</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i>
  port<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-fn">Number</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>process<i class="t-pun">.</i>env<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-typ">PORT</i> <i class="t-pun">??</i> <i class="t-num">3000</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>

  <i class="t-kw">async</i> <i class="t-fn">fetch</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
    <i class="t-kw">const</i> url <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-kw">new</i> <i class="t-typ">URL</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">.</i>url<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

    <i class="t-kw">for</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-kw">const</i> route <i class="t-kw">of</i> routes<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>method <i class="t-pun">!</i><i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">=</i> request<i class="t-pun">.</i>method<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">continue</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

      <i class="t-kw">const</i> params <i class="t-pun">=</i> <i class="t-fn">match</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>route<i class="t-pun">.</i>pattern<i class="t-pun">,</i> url<i class="t-pun">.</i>pathname<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
      <i class="t-kw">if</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i>params<i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-kw">await</i> route<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">handler</i><i class="t-pun">(</i>request<i class="t-pun">,</i> params<i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
    <i class="t-pun">}</i>

    <i class="t-kw">return</i> <i class="t-typ">Response</i><i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">json</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">{</i> error<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-str">"Recurso não encontrado"</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> status<i class="t-pun">:</i> <i class="t-num">404</i> <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>
  <i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">,</i>
<i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

console<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">log</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">`Servidor executando em http://localhost:${server.port}`</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>

 for (let i = 0; i &lt; patternParts.length; i++) {</span><span class="dl ctx">     const expected = patternParts[i]!;</span><span class="dl ctx">     const received = pathParts[i]!;</span><span <header class="fase-head">
  <div class="fase-n">23</div>
  <div class="fase-t"><h2>🔬 TEMPO 2 — a regra não é testável sozinha</h2></div>
</header>
<div class="fase-body">
  <div class="lead"><p>🔬 Você tenta escrever o teste que resolveria tudo: um teste só da regra do limite, sem servidor, sem porta, sem banco, sem CSV. E descobre que ele <strong>não existe</strong> — não porque falta biblioteca, mas porque não há nada para importar.</p></div>

  <div class="step"><h3>👨‍💻 O que você digita</h3><p>Crie o arquivo abaixo. Ele não testa nada — documenta uma impossibilidade, e usa <code>test.todo</code> para que ela apareça no relatório do runner.</p>

<p><strong><code>tests/regra-isolada.test.ts</code></strong> — arquivo novo</p>
<div class="cb">
<div class="cb-bar"><span class="cb-lang">typescript</span><div class="cb-actions"><button class="cp" data-code="c431">copiar</button></div></div>
<pre class="cb-body" id="c431"><code><i class="t-kw">import</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i> test <i class="t-pun">}</i> <i class="t-kw">from</i> <i class="t-str">"bun:test"</i><i class="t-pun">;</i>

<i class="t-com">// Objetivo: testar SÓ a regra do limite de livros.</i>
<i class="t-com">// Sem servidor. Sem porta. Sem banco. Sem CSV.</i>
<i class="t-com">//</i>
<i class="t-com">// O import que gostaríamos de escrever é este:</i>
<i class="t-com">//</i>
<i class="t-com">//   import { limiteDeLivros } from "../src/index";</i>
<i class="t-com">//</i>
<i class="t-com">// Ele não compila, e não é por falta de export.</i>
<i class="t-com">// A regra não é uma função: é um `if` dentro de um `handler`, dentro de um</i>
<i class="t-com">// objeto, dentro do array `routes`, dentro de `src/index.ts` — que, ao ser</i>
<i class="t-com">// importado, sobe um servidor HTTP na porta 3000 como efeito colateral.</i>
<i class="t-com">//</i>
<i class="t-com">// Para exercitar essa regra hoje só existem dois caminhos:</i>
<i class="t-com">//   1. subir a aplicação inteira e falar HTTP com ela (tests/cadastro.e2e.test.ts)</i>
<i class="t-com">//   2. subir um processo da CLI e falar CSV com ela (tests/importacao.test.ts)</i>
<i class="t-com">//</i>
<i class="t-com">// Nenhum dos dois testa a regra. Os dois testam a regra ATRAVÉS de um</i>
<i class="t-com">// mecanismo de entrega — e é por isso que a mesma regra precisou ser escrita</i>
<i class="t-com">// duas vezes, e por isso uma das duas está errada agora.</i>

test<i class="t-pun">.</i><i class="t-fn">todo</i><i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-str">"a regra do limite de livros deveria ser testável sozinha"</i><i class="t-pun">,</i> <i class="t-pun">(</i><i class="t-pun">)</i> <i class="t-pun">=</i><i class="t-pun">&gt;</i> <i class="t-pun">{</i><i class="t-pun">}</i><i class="t-pun">)</i><i class="t-pun">;</i></code></pre>
</div></div>
